3.22.s:
3.106
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
āvāhanānyato vacmi yānyahaṃ yadunandana ..
teṣāmante paṭhecchlokaṃ pratyekasya mahābhuja .. 1 ..
3.22.d:
3.106
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
आवाहनान्यतो वच्मि यान्यहं यदुनन्दन ॥
तेषामन्ते पठेच्छ्लोकं प्रत्येकस्य महाभुज ॥ 1 ॥
3.22.m:
3.106
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
I shall now declare further invocations, O joy of the Yadus;
at the conclusion of each one, O mighty-armed one, one should recite this verse:

3.22.s:
yājakaṃ yajamānaṃ ca śreyasābhyetya yojaya ..
idamarghyamidaṃ pādyaṃ dhūpoyaṃ pratigṛhyatām .. 2 ..
3.22.d:
याजकं यजमानं च श्रेयसाभ्येत्य योजय ॥
इदमर्घ्यमिदं पाद्यं धूपोयं प्रतिगृह्यताम् ॥ 2 ॥
3.22.m:
"Come and unite both the officiating priest and the patron of the sacrifice with the highest good;
let this water for respectful offering, this water for the feet, and this incense be accepted."

3.22.s:
āvāhayāmyahaṃ devaṃ vāsudevaṃ jagatpatim ..
amṛtādhmātameghābhaṃ vidyudṛśavasāsasam .. 3 ..
3.22.d:
आवाहयाम्यहं देवं वासुदेवं जगत्पतिम् ॥
अमृताध्मातमेघाभं विद्युदृशवसाससम् ॥ 3 ॥
3.22.m:
I invoke the divine Vāsudeva, lord of the universe,
resembling a cloud filled with nectar, with garments like flashes of lightning,

3.22.s:
caturvaktraṃ mahābāhuṃ caturvedadharaṃ prabhum ..
caturāśramagoptāraṃ cāturvarṇyadharaṃ tathā .. 4 ..
3.22.d:
चतुर्वक्त्रं महाबाहुं चतुर्वेदधरं प्रभुम् ॥
चतुराश्रमगोप्तारं चातुर्वर्ण्यधरं तथा ॥ 4 ॥
3.22.m:
four-faced, mighty-armed, the lord who sustains the four Vedas,
protector of the four stages of life, and maintainer of the four social classes,

3.22.s:
caturyugaṃ catuṣketuṃ caturmūrtidharaṃ param ..
caturaṃghritanuṃ nāthaṃ caturvidhavibhāvanama .. 5 ..
3.22.d:
चतुर्युगं चतुष्केतुं चतुर्मूर्तिधरं परम् ॥
चतुरंघ्रितनुं नाथं चतुर्विधविभावनम ॥ 5 ॥
3.22.m:
manifest as the four ages, having four emblems, supreme bearer of the four forms,
the lord whose body consists of four quarters, who displays himself in fourfold manner,

3.22.s:
jarāyujasya kartavyaṃ tathā cāṇḍodbhavasya ca ..
sarvagaṃ varadaṃ nityaṃ sūkṣmaṃ sthūlamajaṃ vibhum .. 6 ..
3.22.d:
जरायुजस्य कर्तव्यं तथा चाण्डोद्भवस्य च ॥
सर्वगं वरदं नित्यं सूक्ष्मं स्थूलमजं विभुम् ॥ 6 ॥
3.22.m:
the maker of both the womb-born and the egg-born,
all-pervading, boon-granting, eternal, subtle and gross, unborn and all-powerful,

3.22.s:
ātmasthaṃ ca bahisthaṃ ca dūrasthaṃ cāntikaṃ ca tam ..
guṇādhāraṃ guṇairhīnaṃ guṇātītaṃ guṇottaram .. 7 ..
3.22.d:
आत्मस्थं च बहिस्थं च दूरस्थं चान्तिकं च तम् ॥
गुणाधारं गुणैर्हीनं गुणातीतं गुणोत्तरम् ॥ 7 ॥
3.22.m:
dwelling within the self and dwelling outside, far off and yet near,
the foundation of qualities, devoid of qualities, transcending qualities, beyond all qualities,

3.22.s:
saguṇaṃ nirguṇātmānaṃ cājeyaṃ jagataḥ parama ..
ehi me puṇḍarīkākṣa śaraṇāgata vatsala ..8..
3.22.d:
सगुणं निर्गुणात्मानं चाजेयं जगतः परम ॥
एहि मे पुण्डरीकाक्ष शरणागत वत्सल ॥8॥
3.22.m:
possessed of qualities yet having the nature of the quality-less, invincible, supreme over the world:
Come to me, lotus-eyed one, affectionate to those who take refuge in you,

3.22.s:
kṣaraparyantavaktrāntarnirastāsuramaṇḍala ..
gadāveganirastogradaityanāthagaṇeśvara ..9..
3.22.d:
क्षरपर्यन्तवक्त्रान्तर्निरस्तासुरमण्डल ॥
गदावेगनिरस्तोग्रदैत्यनाथगणेश्वर ॥9॥
3.22.m:
you who have cast out the host of asuras within your mouth that reaches the end of creation,
you who repelled the fierce lords of the daitya armies by the force of your mace,

3.22.s:
utphullacārukamalavirājitakarāmbuja ..
śaṅkhanādodbhavaśvāsamūḍhīkṛtamahāsura .. 3.106.10 ..
3.22.d:
उत्फुल्लचारुकमलविराजितकराम्बुज ॥
शङ्खनादोद्भवश्वासमूढीकृतमहासुर ॥ 3.106.10 ॥
3.22.m:
whose lotus hands are adorned with an open, lovely lotus,
who stupefied the great asuras with the breath born of your conch's blast,

3.22.s:
mahīkarāmbujanyastacaraṇadvayarājita ..
kaustubhodbhūtagojālahatāsuravilocana .. 11 ..
3.22.d:
महीकराम्बुजन्यस्तचरणद्वयराजित ॥
कौस्तुभोद्भूतगोजालहतासुरविलोचन ॥ 11 ॥
3.22.m:
splendid with both feet placed upon the lotus-like hands of the Earth,
who destroyed the eyes of the asuras with the web of rays issuing from the Kaustubha gem,

3.22.s:
vanamālāṅkitoraska kirīṭodbhāsitānana ..
yajña yajñopayajñāṅgayajñayone jagadguro .. 12 ..
3.22.d:
वनमालाङ्कितोरस्क किरीटोद्भासितानन ॥
यज्ञ यज्ञोपयज्ञाङ्गयज्ञयोने जगद्गुरो ॥ 12 ॥
3.22.m:
whose chest is marked with the forest garland, whose face is illuminated by a diadem,
O sacrifice, O you who are the subsidiary rites of sacrifice, origin of sacrifice, teacher of the world,

3.22.s:
sarvakāmapradācintya sarvaśaktibalānvita ..
āvāhayāmyahaṃ devaṃ saṅkarṣaṇamayonijam .. 13 ..
3.22.d:
सर्वकामप्रदाचिन्त्य सर्वशक्तिबलान्वित ॥
आवाहयाम्यहं देवं सङ्कर्षणमयोनिजम् ॥ 13 ॥
3.22.m:
granter of all desires, inconceivable one, endowed with all powers and might:
I invoke the unborn god Saṃkarṣaṇa,

3.22.s:
śaśāṅkaśatasaṅkāśaṃ sajalāmbudavāsasam ..
krodhāgniśamitāśeṣakalpāṃtabhuvanatrayam .. 14 ..
3.22.d:
शशाङ्कशतसङ्काशं सजलाम्बुदवाससम् ॥
क्रोधाग्निशमिताशेषकल्पांतभुवनत्रयम् ॥ 14 ॥
3.22.m:
resembling a hundred moons, clothed in water-laden clouds,
who appeased the three worlds at the end of the aeon with the fire of his wrath,

3.22.s:
vāṅmanaḥkāyasambhūtamalatritayanāśanam ..
ehi saṃkarṣaṇācintya deva bhaktajanapriya .. 15 ..
3.22.d:
वाङ्मनःकायसम्भूतमलत्रितयनाशनम् ॥
एहि संकर्षणाचिन्त्य देव भक्तजनप्रिय ॥ 15 ॥
3.22.m:
the destroyer of the threefold impurity born of speech, mind, and body:
Come, inconceivable Saṃkarṣaṇa, O god dear to your devotees,

3.22.s:
lāṅgūlākṛṣṭadaityendra dīnekṣaṇanirīkṣaṇa ..
musalāgravinirbhinna tamomūrtivināśana .. 16 ..
3.22.d:
लाङ्गूलाकृष्टदैत्येन्द्र दीनेक्षणनिरीक्षण ॥
मुसलाग्रविनिर्भिन्न तमोमूर्तिविनाशन ॥ 16 ॥
3.22.m:
you who dragged the daitya kings with your plough, whose glance looks upon the miserable,
who shattered and destroyed the embodiments of darkness with the tip of your pestle,

3.22.s:
hārdamūrte niśīthasya tamasaśca vināśaka ..
devamāvāhayiṣyāmi pradyumnamaparājitam .. 17 ..
3.22.d:
हार्दमूर्ते निशीथस्य तमसश्च विनाशक ॥
देवमावाहयिष्यामि प्रद्युम्नमपराजितम् ॥ 17 ॥
3.22.m:
whose form is within the heart, destroyer of the darkness of the dead of night:
I shall invoke the unconquered god Pradyumna,

3.22.s:
dūrvāṅkuradalaśyāmaṃ śaśāṅkāṃśusamāmba ram ..
kāmaṃ kāmapradaṃ śāntaṃ kamanīyaṃ suśobhitam .. 18 ..
3.22.d:
दूर्वाङ्कुरदलश्यामं शशाङ्कांशुसमाम्ब रम् ॥
कामं कामप्रदं शान्तं कमनीयं सुशोभितम् ॥ 18 ॥
3.22.m:
dark as the blade of a dūrvā sprout, with garments like the rays of the moon,
desire itself, granter of desires, tranquil, lovely, exceedingly radiant,

3.22.s:
sarvamānabhṛtāṃ devaṃ manoviṣayagocaram ..
pradyumnābhyehi deveśa pradyotitacarācara .. 19 ..
3.22.d:
सर्वमानभृतां देवं मनोविषयगोचरम् ॥
प्रद्युम्नाभ्येहि देवेश प्रद्योतितचराचर ॥ 19 ॥
3.22.m:
the god who is the object of the mind's domain for all who possess consciousness:
O Pradyumna, come, lord of gods, illuminator of all that moves and is still,

3.22.s:
tejomūrte durādharṣaṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabha ..
ajñātamadhyaparyanta devārigaṇanāśana .. 3.106.20 ..
3.22.d:
तेजोमूर्ते दुराधर्षं सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभ ॥
अज्ञातमध्यपर्यन्त देवारिगणनाशन ॥ 3.106.20 ॥
3.22.m:
whose form is brilliance, unassailable, with splendour like ten million suns,
whose middle and limits are unknown, destroyer of the hosts of the gods' enemies,

3.22.s:
cāpakṛṣṭivinirmuktaśarāhatajagattraya ..
āvāhayāmyahaṃ devaṃ cāniruddhaṃ jagadgurum ..21..
3.22.d:
चापकृष्टिविनिर्मुक्तशराहतजगत्त्रय ॥
आवाहयाम्यहं देवं चानिरुद्धं जगद्गुरुम् ॥21॥
3.22.m:
who struck the three worlds with arrows released from his drawn bow:
I invoke the god Aniruddha, teacher of the world,

3.22.s:
padmapatrāgrasaṅkāśaṃ raktāmbaravibhūṣaṇam ..
aruddhamārgaṃ sarvatra dīptānalasamaprabham..22..
3.22.d:
पद्मपत्राग्रसङ्काशं रक्ताम्बरविभूषणम् ॥
अरुद्धमार्गं सर्वत्र दीप्तानलसमप्रभम्॥22॥
3.22.m:
resembling the tip of a lotus petal, adorned with red garments,
whose path is unobstructed everywhere, with splendour equal to blazing fire,

3.22.s:
kāryaṃ paramamīśānaṃ jagatkāraṇakāraṇam ..
aniruddha tvamabhyehi vyāptāśeṣacarācara .. 23..
3.22.d:
कार्यं परममीशानं जगत्कारणकारणम् ॥
अनिरुद्ध त्वमभ्येहि व्याप्ताशेषचराचर ॥ 23॥
3.22.m:
the supreme effect, the sovereign, the cause of the causes of the world:
O Aniruddha, come, you who pervade all that moves and is still,

3.22.s:
ākāśatulyasadvajravidāritasurāhita ..
carmasañchāditāśeṣabhuvanāditya vikrama..24..
(sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ karmma saṃsāraparipālaka ..24..)
3.22.d:
आकाशतुल्यसद्वज्रविदारितसुराहित ॥
चर्मसञ्छादिताशेषभुवनादित्य विक्रम॥24॥
(सर्वेषां प्राणिनां कर्म्म संसारपरिपालक ॥24॥)
3.22.m:
who tore apart the enemies of the gods with your true thunderbolt resembling the sky,
who covered all the worlds with your shield, possessing the valour of the sun,
[you who are the action of all living beings, protector of worldly existence.]

3.22.s:
āvāhayiṣye varadaṃ cānanta dīptatejasam ..
phaṇāvaligatāśīrṣamahīmaṇḍaladhāriṇam ..25..
3.22.d:
आवाहयिष्ये वरदं चानन्त दीप्ततेजसम् ॥
फणावलिगताशीर्षमहीमण्डलधारिणम् ॥25॥
3.22.m:
I shall invoke the boon-granting Ananta of blazing splendour,
who supports the orb of the earth upon the heads of his array of hoods,

3.22.s:
lāṃgalāliṅgatakaraṃ musalāsaktavigraham ..
mahocchritena tālena tathā cihnena rājitam..26..
3.22.d:
लांगलालिङ्गतकरं मुसलासक्तविग्रहम् ॥
महोच्छ्रितेन तालेन तथा चिह्नेन राजितम्॥26॥
3.22.m:
whose hand embraces a plough, whose body is joined to a pestle,
splendid with his emblem, a very tall palm tree:

3.22.s:
ehyananta mahābhāga śeṣāhe dharaṇīdhara ..
śaśāṅka śatasaṅkāśa tathāmbarasuśobhita .. 27 ..
3.22.d:
एह्यनन्त महाभाग शेषाहे धरणीधर ॥
शशाङ्क शतसङ्काश तथाम्बरसुशोभित ॥ 27 ॥
3.22.m:
Come, Ananta, most fortunate one, serpent Śeṣa, supporter of the earth,
resembling a hundred moons, brilliantly adorned with such garments;

3.22.s:
ādhāraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ tvameko bhūtabhāvanaḥ ..
tvayedaṃ dhāryate viśvaṃ trailokyaṃ ca jagatpate .. 28 ..
3.22.d:
आधारः सर्वभूतानां त्वमेको भूतभावनः ॥
त्वयेदं धार्यते विश्वं त्रैलोक्यं च जगत्पते ॥ 28 ॥
3.22.m:
you alone are the foundation of all beings, the creator of beings;
by you this universe and the three worlds are sustained, O lord of the world.

3.22.s:
lakṣmīmāvāhayiṣyāmi viṣṇorvakṣasi saṃsthitām ..
padmānanāṃ padmakarāṃ śaśāṃkasadṛśāmbarām .. 29 ..
3.22.d:
लक्ष्मीमावाहयिष्यामि विष्णोर्वक्षसि संस्थिताम् ॥
पद्माननां पद्मकरां शशांकसदृशाम्बराम् ॥ 29 ॥
3.22.m:
I shall invoke Lakṣmī, who rests upon the chest of Viṣṇu,
with lotus-like face, holding a lotus in her hand, with garments resembling the moon,

3.22.s:
hitasthāṃ sarvalokasya varadāṃ kāmarūpiṇīm ..
sarvagāṃ sarvajananīṃ devīṃ tribhuvaneśvarīm .. 3.106.30 ..
3.22.d:
हितस्थां सर्वलोकस्य वरदां कामरूपिणीम् ॥
सर्वगां सर्वजननीं देवीं त्रिभुवनेश्वरीम् ॥ 3.106.30 ॥
3.22.m:
abiding for the welfare of all the world, boon-granting, assuming forms at will,
all-pervading, mother of all, goddess and sovereign of the three worlds:

3.22.s:
āgaccha varade lakṣmi durdhare bhūtabhāvane ..
haripriye viśālākṣi sarvalokanamaskṛte .. 31 ..
3.22.d:
आगच्छ वरदे लक्ष्मि दुर्धरे भूतभावने ॥
हरिप्रिये विशालाक्षि सर्वलोकनमस्कृते ॥ 31 ॥
3.22.m:
Come, boon-granting Lakṣmī, unassailable, creator of beings,
beloved of Hari, wide-eyed one, revered by all the worlds.

3.22.s:
yatra tvaṃ tatra sakalaṃ trailokyaṃ varavarṇini ..
yunakṣi bhogaiḥ sakalaṃ smṛtiprāptaṃ janaṃ śubham .. 32 ..
3.22.d:
यत्र त्वं तत्र सकलं त्रैलोक्यं वरवर्णिनि ॥
युनक्षि भोगैः सकलं स्मृतिप्राप्तं जनं शुभम् ॥ 32 ॥
3.22.m: Where you are, there is the entire triple world, O fair-complexioned one; / you unite with all enjoyments the virtuous person who remembers you.

3.22.s:
tārkṣyamāvāhayiṣyāmi manomārutaraṃhasam ..
pakṣavātasamuddhūtasamastabhuvanatrayam .. 33 ..
3.22.d:
तार्क्ष्यमावाहयिष्यामि मनोमारुतरंहसम् ॥
पक्षवातसमुद्धूतसमस्तभुवनत्रयम् ॥ 33 ॥
3.22.m: I will invoke Tārkṣya, who has the speed of mind and wind, / by the wind of whose wings the entire triple world is shaken.

3.22.s:
garuḍairhi samabhyehi dīptānalacayopama ..
mahāviṣatamograstanirviṣīkaraṇācyuta .. 34 ..
3.22.d:
गरुडैर्हि समभ्येहि दीप्तानलचयोपम ॥
महाविषतमोग्रस्तनिर्विषीकरणाच्युत ॥ 34 ॥
3.22.m: Come, Garuḍa, come forward, like a mass of blazing fire, / you who are unfailing in removing poison swallowed in the darkness of great venom.

3.22.s:
tālamāvāhayiṣyāmi ketuṃ saṃkarṣaṇasya tu ..
ehi me bhagavam̐stāla samastabhuvaneśvara .. 35 ..
3.22.d:
तालमावाहयिष्यामि केतुं संकर्षणस्य तु ॥
एहि मे भगवम्̐स्ताल समस्तभुवनेश्वर ॥ 35 ॥
3.22.m: I will invoke the palmyra palm, the banner of Saṃkarṣaṇa. / Come to me, Lord Palmyra, ruler of all the worlds.

3.22.s:
jhaṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi kāmaketuṃ varapradam ..
ehi me makarāgryeha samastabhuvaneśvara .. 36 ..
3.22.d:
झषमावाहयिष्यामि कामकेतुं वरप्रदम् ॥
एहि मे मकराग्र्येह समस्तभुवनेश्वर ॥ 36 ॥
3.22.m: I will invoke the fish, the boon-granting banner of Kāma. / Come to me, foremost of sea-monsters, here, ruler of all the worlds.

3.22.s:
ṛṣyamāvāhayiṣyāmi ṛṣirājaṃ mahābalam ..
ehi ṛṣya mahābhāga karmamūrte durāsada ..37..
3.22.d:
ऋष्यमावाहयिष्यामि ऋषिराजं महाबलम् ॥
एहि ऋष्य महाभाग कर्ममूर्ते दुरासद ॥37॥
3.22.m: I will invoke the white-footed antelope, the mighty king of antelopes. / Come, highly fortunate antelope, form of ritual action, unassailable one.

3.22.s:
devamāvāhayiṣyāmi nṛsiṃhaṃ jñānarūpiṇam ..
daṃṣṭrākarālavadanamalātamasitekṣaṇam .. 38 ..
3.22.d:
देवमावाहयिष्यामि नृसिंहं ज्ञानरूपिणम् ॥
दंष्ट्राकरालवदनमलातमसितेक्षणम् ॥ 38 ॥
3.22.m: I will invoke the god Nṛsiṃha, whose form is knowledge, / whose mouth is terrifying with fangs, who has dark eyes like a firebrand,

3.22.s:
sahasrayamasakrodhaṃ sahasrendraparākramam ..
sahasradhanadanaṃ sphītaṃ manasopyatiśīghragam .. .. 39 ..
3.22.d:
सहस्रयमसक्रोधं सहस्रेन्द्रपराक्रमम् ॥
सहस्रधनदनं स्फीतं मनसोप्यतिशीघ्रगम् ॥ ॥ 39 ॥
3.22.m: having the wrath of a thousand Yamas, the valour of a thousand Indras, / rich as a thousand Kuberas, moving swifter even than thought,

3.22.s:
vidyujjihvaṃ vyāditāsyaṃ bhrukuṭīkuṭilānanam ..
vahnijvālāvalīpuñjadurnirīkṣyamukhaśriyam ..3.106.40 ..
3.22.d:
विद्युज्जिह्वं व्यादितास्यं भ्रुकुटीकुटिलाननम् ॥
वह्निज्वालावलीपुञ्जदुर्निरीक्ष्यमुखश्रियम् ॥3.106.40 ॥
3.22.m: with a lightning-like tongue, a gaping mouth, and a face furrowed with a frown, / the splendour of whose face is difficult to look upon like a heap of blazing flames.

3.22.s:
āgaccheha nṛsiṃhādya mahābalaparākrama ..
vajratīkṣṇanakhākrāntamahādaityendrajīvita .. 41 ..
3.22.d:
आगच्छेह नृसिंहाद्य महाबलपराक्रम ॥
वज्रतीक्ष्णनखाक्रान्तमहादैत्येन्द्रजीवित ॥ 41 ॥
3.22.m: Come here today, Nṛsiṃha of great strength and prowess, / who crushed the life of the great lord of daityas with claws sharp as thunderbolts,

3.22.s:
ajñānadhvāntamātaṅgabhaṅgavispaṣṭakesara ..
mahāmantrakapāṭogradāruṇācintyavikrama .. 42 ..
3.22.d:
अज्ञानध्वान्तमातङ्गभङ्गविस्पष्टकेसर ॥
महामन्त्रकपाटोग्रदारुणाचिन्त्यविक्रम ॥ 42 ॥
3.22.m: whose mane is distinct in shattering the elephant that is the darkness of ignorance, / who has incomprehensible prowess, fierce and dreadful like a door of great mantras.

3.22.s:
devamāvāhayiṣyāmi kāpilīṃ tanumāśritam ..
tejonidhānamajitaṃ sāgarātmajavāḍavam .. 43 ..
3.22.d:
देवमावाहयिष्यामि कापिलीं तनुमाश्रितम् ॥
तेजोनिधानमजितं सागरात्मजवाडवम् ॥ 43 ॥
3.22.m: I will invoke the god who assumed the form of Kapila, / the unconquered store of splendour, the submarine fire to the sons of Sagara.

3.22.s:
ehi me kapilādyeha paramātmansanātana ..
dhyānavīkṣitasadbhāva sāṃkhyamārgapravartaka .. 44 ..
3.22.d:
एहि मे कपिलाद्येह परमात्मन्सनातन ॥
ध्यानवीक्षितसद्भाव सांख्यमार्गप्रवर्तक ॥ 44 ॥
3.22.m: Come to me here today, Kapila, eternal Supreme Self, / whose true nature is seen in meditation, promulgator of the path of Sāṃkhya.

3.22.s:
devamāvāhayiṣyāmi nṛvarāhaṃ mahābalam ..
bhinnāñjanacayaśyāma līloddhṛtavasundhara .. 45 ..
3.22.d:
देवमावाहयिष्यामि नृवराहं महाबलम् ॥
भिन्नाञ्जनचयश्याम लीलोद्धृतवसुन्धर ॥ 45 ॥
3.22.m: I will invoke the god, the mighty Man-Boar, / dark as a heap of split collyrium, who lifted up the earth in play.

3.22.s:
āgaccha nṛvarāheha hiraṇyākṣavināśana ..
śeṣābhabhogavinyastamahācaraṇapaṅkaja .. 46 ..
3.22.d:
आगच्छ नृवराहेह हिरण्याक्षविनाशन ॥
शेषाभभोगविन्यस्तमहाचरणपङ्कज ॥ 46 ॥
3.22.m: Come here, Man-Boar, destroyer of Hiraṇyākṣa, / whose great lotus feet are placed upon the coils of Śeṣa.

3.22.s:
śaṅkhanādodbhava trāhi niyantā suranāyakam ..
devamāvāhayiṣyāmi varāhaṃ varadarpitam .. 47 ..
3.22.d:
शङ्खनादोद्भव त्राहि नियन्ता सुरनायकम् ॥
देवमावाहयिष्यामि वराहं वरदर्पितम् ॥ 47 ॥
3.22.m: O you who arose from the blast of the conch, protect [us], ruler of the leader of the gods! / I will invoke the god, the Boar proud of his boons,

3.22.s:
bālendulekhādaṃṣṭrāgravibhāsitajagattraya ..
vismayotphullanayana bhūmivīkṣitavigraha .. 48 ..
3.22.d:
बालेन्दुलेखादंष्ट्राग्रविभासितजगत्त्रय ॥
विस्मयोत्फुल्लनयन भूमिवीक्षितविग्रह ॥ 48 ॥
3.22.m: who illuminated the triple world with the tip of his crescent-moon-like tusk, / whose eyes expanded with wonder, whose form was gazed upon by the Earth,

3.22.s:
bālendutulyadaṃṣṭrāgra līloddhṛtavasundhara ..
ehi me bhagavandeva varāhāmitavikrama .. 49 ..
3.22.d:
बालेन्दुतुल्यदंष्ट्राग्र लीलोद्धृतवसुन्धर ॥
एहि मे भगवन्देव वराहामितविक्रम ॥ 49 ॥
3.22.m: who lifted up the earth in play with the tip of his tusk resembling the crescent moon. / Come to me, Lord God, Boar of boundless prowess,

3.22.s:
nirastāśeṣadaityeṃdra dīnabhaktajanoddhara ..
dharmamāvāhayiṣyāmi sarvabhūtasukhāvaham .. 3.106.50 ..
3.22.d:
निरस्ताशेषदैत्येंद्र दीनभक्तजनोद्धर ॥
धर्ममावाहयिष्यामि सर्वभूतसुखावहम् ॥ 3.106.50 ॥
3.22.m: who drove away all the lordly daityas, uplifter of miserable devotees! / I will invoke Dharma, who brings happiness to all beings,

3.22.s:
durvijñeyaṃ bahudvāraṃ khalamūrtidurāsadam ..
ehi dharma mamābhyehi bhuvanatrayapālaka .. 51 ..
3.22.d:
दुर्विज्ञेयं बहुद्वारं खलमूर्तिदुरासदम् ॥
एहि धर्म ममाभ्येहि भुवनत्रयपालक ॥ 51 ॥
3.22.m: hard to know, possessing many doors, unapproachable by the wicked. / Come, Dharma, approach me, protector of the triple world,

3.22.s:
samastapāpaśamana sarvabādhāvināśana ..
rudramāvāhayiṣyāmi tejomūrtiṃ durāsadam .. 52 ..
3.22.d:
समस्तपापशमन सर्वबाधाविनाशन ॥
रुद्रमावाहयिष्यामि तेजोमूर्तिं दुरासदम् ॥ 52 ॥
3.22.m: calmer of all sins, destroyer of all afflictions! / I will invoke Rudra, whose form is splendour, who is difficult to approach,

3.22.s:
aiśvaryamatigambhīraṃ sarvasaṃhārakārakam ..
ehi me bhagavannrudra jaṭāmaṇḍala durdṛśa .. 53 ..
3.22.d:
ऐश्वर्यमतिगम्भीरं सर्वसंहारकारकम् ॥
एहि मे भगवन्न्रुद्र जटामण्डल दुर्दृश ॥ 53 ॥
3.22.m: whose sovereignty is exceedingly profound, the cause of the dissolution of all. / Come to me, Lord Rudra, difficult to look upon with your circle of matted hair,

3.22.s:
nirdagdhāśeṣabhuvana tṛtīyekṣaṇatejasā ..
devamāvāhayiṣyāmi brāhmaṇaṃ dīptatejasam .. 54 ..
3.22.d:
निर्दग्धाशेषभुवन तृतीयेक्षणतेजसा ॥
देवमावाहयिष्यामि ब्राह्मणं दीप्ततेजसम् ॥ 54 ॥
3.22.m: who completely burned all the worlds with the splendour of your third eye! / I will invoke the god Brahmā, of blazing splendour,

3.22.s:
caturmukhaṃ caturbāhuṃ guṇādhīnaṃ guṇottaram ..
devadeva tvamabhyehi pitāmaha sureśvara .. 55 ..
3.22.d:
चतुर्मुखं चतुर्बाहुं गुणाधीनं गुणोत्तरम् ॥
देवदेव त्वमभ्येहि पितामह सुरेश्वर ॥ 55 ॥
3.22.m: four-faced, four-armed, dependent upon the guṇas yet superior to the guṇas. / Come, God of gods, Grandfather, Lord of gods,

3.22.s:
samastabhuvanādhyakṣa jagatkāraṇakāraṇa ..
bhūmimāvāhayiṣyāmi dhāriṇīṃ sarvadehinām .. 56 ..
3.22.d:
समस्तभुवनाध्यक्ष जगत्कारणकारण ॥
भूमिमावाहयिष्यामि धारिणीं सर्वदेहिनाम् ॥ 56 ॥
3.22.m: overseer of all the worlds, cause of the cause of the universe! / I will invoke the Earth, supporter of all embodied beings,

3.22.s:
sarvabhūtapratiṣṭhāṃ ca kṣitiṃ kṣoṇīṃ sarasvatīm ..
ehi me varade devi vasudhe bhūtabhāvini .. 57 ..
3.22.d:
सर्वभूतप्रतिष्ठां च क्षितिं क्षोणीं सरस्वतीम् ॥
एहि मे वरदे देवि वसुधे भूतभाविनि ॥ 57 ॥
3.22.m: the foundation of all beings, Kṣiti, Kṣoṇī, Sarasvatī. / Come to me, boon-granting goddess, Vasudhā, creator of beings,

3.22.s: sarvāśraye mahābhāge devavadbhayahāriṇi .. 58 ..
3.22.d: सर्वाश्रये महाभागे देववद्भयहारिणि ॥ 58 ॥
3.22.m: refuge of all, highly fortunate, dispelling fear like a deity!

3.22.s: śaṅkhamāvāhayiṣyāmi nabhomūrtimathāvyayam .. 59 ..
3.22.d: शङ्खमावाहयिष्यामि नभोमूर्तिमथाव्ययम् ॥ 59 ॥
3.22.m: I will invoke the conch, whose form is the sky, imperishable,

3.22.s:
śabdayoniṃ nirālambaṃ samastabhuvanāśrayam ..
ehyehi śaṅkhapravara pāñcajanya mahāsvana .. 3.106.60 ..
3.22.d:
शब्दयोनिं निरालम्बं समस्तभुवनाश्रयम् ॥
एह्येहि शङ्खप्रवर पाञ्चजन्य महास्वन ॥ 3.106.60 ॥
3.22.m: the origin of sound, without support, the refuge of all the worlds. / Come, come, foremost of conches, Pāñcajanya of mighty sound,

3.22.s:
śabdamātrahatāśeṣamahādānavamaṇḍala ..
padmamāvāhayiṣyāmi samastabhuvanāśrayam .. 61 ..
3.22.d:
शब्दमात्रहताशेषमहादानवमण्डल ॥
पद्ममावाहयिष्यामि समस्तभुवनाश्रयम् ॥ 61 ॥
3.22.m: who slew the entire circle of great dānavas by mere sound! / I will invoke the lotus, the refuge of all the worlds,

3.22.s:
apāṃ mūrtimayaṃ saumyaṃ puṇḍarīkamiti smṛtam ..
ehi padma mahābhāga bhūtabhavyabhavaprabho .. 62 ..
3.22.d:
अपां मूर्तिमयं सौम्यं पुण्डरीकमिति स्मृतम् ॥
एहि पद्म महाभाग भूतभव्यभवप्रभो ॥ 62 ॥
3.22.m: composed of the form of water, gentle, remembered as the white lotus. / Come, lotus, highly fortunate one, lord of past, present, and future,

3.22.s:
lakṣmīnilaya vistīrṇa brahmayone jaganmaya ..
cakramāvāhayiṣyāmi kṣaratparyantamaṇḍalam .. 63 ..
3.22.d:
लक्ष्मीनिलय विस्तीर्ण ब्रह्मयोने जगन्मय ॥
चक्रमावाहयिष्यामि क्षरत्पर्यन्तमण्डलम् ॥ 63 ॥
3.22.m: abode of Lakṣmī, vast, source of Brahmā, containing the universe! / I will invoke the discus, whose circular rim pours forth [splendour],

3.22.s:
vajranābhaṃ viśālākṣaṃ vāyumūrjitamavyayam ..
kālacakraṃ jagaccakraṃ dharmacakraṃ sudarśanam .. 64 ..
3.22.d:
वज्रनाभं विशालाक्षं वायुमूर्जितमव्ययम् ॥
कालचक्रं जगच्चक्रं धर्मचक्रं सुदर्शनम् ॥ 64 ॥
3.22.m: with a thunderbolt navel, wide-eyed, possessing the form of wind, mighty, imperishable, / the wheel of time, the wheel of the universe, the wheel of dharma, Sudarśana,

3.22.s:
nityaṃ satatagaṃ devaṃ tṛptaṃ dānavaśoṇitaiḥ ..
ehi cakrāmitaśita jagatpālanatatpara .. 65 ..
3.22.d:
नित्यं सततगं देवं तृप्तं दानवशोणितैः ॥
एहि चक्रामितशित जगत्पालनतत्पर ॥ 65 ॥
3.22.m: eternal, ever-moving, divine, satiated with the blood of dānavas. / Come, discus of boundless sharpness, intent on protecting the universe,

3.22.s:
devendrahṛdayatrāsatamonāśanatatpara ..
gadāmāvāhayiṣyāmi tejomūrtiṃ durāsadām .. 66 ..
3.22.d:
देवेन्द्रहृदयत्रासतमोनाशनतत्पर ॥
गदामावाहयिष्यामि तेजोमूर्तिं दुरासदाम् ॥ 66 ॥
3.22.m: intent on destroying the darkness of fear in the heart of the lord of gods! / I will invoke the mace, whose form is splendour, difficult to approach,

3.22.s:
gāyatrīṃ devajananīṃ kālarātrīṃ bhayaṅkarīm ..
ehi kaumodaki gade samastāsuranāśini .. 67 ..
3.22.d:
गायत्रीं देवजननीं कालरात्रीं भयङ्करीम् ॥
एहि कौमोदकि गदे समस्तासुरनाशिनि ॥ 67 ॥
3.22.m: Gāyatrī, mother of the gods, Kālarātrī, terrifying. / Come, mace Kaumodakī, destroyer of all asuras,

3.22.s:
yāsāṃ tvaṃ gahvarā proktā vaiṣṇavī tu sudurdharā ..
ahamāvāhayiṣyāmi sāvantaṃ nāma lāṅgalam ..68..
3.22.d:
यासां त्वं गह्वरा प्रोक्ता वैष्णवी तु सुदुर्धरा ॥
अहमावाहयिष्यामि सावन्तं नाम लाङ्गलम् ॥68॥
3.22.m: of whom it is said you are the impenetrable Vaiṣṇavī, exceedingly difficult to withstand! / I will invoke the plough named Sāvanta.

3.22.s:
āgaccha lāṅgalāsyeha vyāhṛtiṃ bhuvanatrayam ..
ahamāvāhayiṣyāmi saudhanvaṃ musalaṃ prabhum .. .. 69 ..
3.22.d:
आगच्छ लाङ्गलास्येह व्याहृतिं भुवनत्रयम् ॥
अहमावाहयिष्यामि सौधन्वं मुसलं प्रभुम् ॥ ॥ 69 ॥
3.22.m: Come here, plough, the vyāhṛti of the triple world! / I will invoke the pestle Saudhanva, the lord.

3.22.s:
āgaccha musalādyeha devārigaṇasūdana ..
cāpamāvāhayiṣyāmi śārṅgaṃ ripuniṣūdanam .. 3.106.70 ..
3.22.d:
आगच्छ मुसलाद्येह देवारिगणसूदन ॥
चापमावाहयिष्यामि शार्ङ्गं रिपुनिषूदनम् ॥ 3.106.70 ॥
3.22.m: Come here today, pestle, slayer of the hosts of the enemies of the gods! / I will invoke the bow Śārṅga, destroyer of foes.

3.22.s:
āgaccha cāpa varada devāsuragaṇapriya ..
śaramāvāhayiṣyāmi mohanaṃ ripumohanam .. 71 ..
3.22.d:
आगच्छ चाप वरद देवासुरगणप्रिय ॥
शरमावाहयिष्यामि मोहनं रिपुमोहनम् ॥ 71 ॥
3.22.m: Come, boon-granting bow, dear to the hosts of gods and asuras! / I will invoke the arrow Mohana, which confounds enemies.

3.22.s:
ehi viddhāribalaja gacchāristribhuvaneśvara ..
carma cāvāhayiṣyāmi khyātamāvaraṇeti yat..72...
3.22.d:
एहि विद्धारिबलज गच्छारिस्त्रिभुवनेश्वर ॥
चर्म चावाहयिष्यामि ख्यातमावरणेति यत्॥72॥।
3.22.m: Come, born of the pierced host of enemies, go against enemies, lord of the triple world! / And I will invoke the shield known as the Cover.

3.22.s:
carmābhyehi viśāla tvaṃ sarvasyāvaraṇaṃ smṛtam ..
khaḍgamāvāhayiṣyāmi nandakaṃ nāma nāmataḥ .. 73 ..
3.22.d:
चर्माभ्येहि विशाल त्वं सर्वस्यावरणं स्मृतम् ॥
खड्गमावाहयिष्यामि नन्दकं नाम नामतः ॥ 73 ॥
3.22.m: Come, broad shield, remembered as the protection of all! / I will invoke the sword, Nandaka by name.

3.22.s:
ehi khaḍga mamāśeṣadaityanāthakulāntaka ...
ahamāvāhayiṣyāmi vanamālāṃ sukhāvahām .. 74 ..
3.22.d:
एहि खड्ग ममाशेषदैत्यनाथकुलान्तक ॥।
अहमावाहयिष्यामि वनमालां सुखावहाम् ॥ 74 ॥
3.22.m: Come to me, sword, destroyer of the race of all the lords of daityas! / I will invoke the forest garland that brings joy.

3.22.s:
vanamāle tvamabhyehi buddhāśeṣajagattraye ..
maṇimāvāhayiṣyāmi kaustubhaṃ keśavāṅgagam ..75...
3.22.d:
वनमाले त्वमभ्येहि बुद्धाशेषजगत्त्रये ॥
मणिमावाहयिष्यामि कौस्तुभं केशवाङ्गगम् ॥75॥।
3.22.m: Come, forest garland, who know the entire triple world! / I will invoke the Kaustubha gem, resting upon Keśava's body.

3.22.s:
kaustubha tvamihābhyehi marīcivikacodbhava ..
devamāvāhayiṣyāmi hariṃ hayaśirodharam .. 76 ..
3.22.d:
कौस्तुभ त्वमिहाभ्येहि मरीचिविकचोद्भव ॥
देवमावाहयिष्यामि हरिं हयशिरोधरम् ॥ 76 ॥
3.22.m: Come here, Kaustubha, origin of blossoming rays! / I will invoke the god Hari, who bears a horse's head,

3.22.s:
śaśāṅkaśatasaṅkāśa vedoddharaṇaniścita ...
hayagrīva tvamabhyehi śaṅkhacakragadādhara .. 77 ..
3.22.d:
शशाङ्कशतसङ्काश वेदोद्धरणनिश्चित ॥।
हयग्रीव त्वमभ्येहि शङ्खचक्रगदाधर ॥ 77 ॥
3.22.m: resembling a hundred moons, determined to rescue the Vedas. / Come, Hayagrīva, holder of the conch, discus, and mace,

3.22.s:
vedāharaṇaduḥkhārtasamāśvāsitapadmaja ..
ahamāvāhayiṣyāmi ṛgvedaṃ padabhūṣitam .. 78 ...
3.22.d:
वेदाहरणदुःखार्तसमाश्वासितपद्मज ॥
अहमावाहयिष्यामि ऋग्वेदं पदभूषितम् ॥ 78 ॥।
3.22.m: who consoled the Lotus-Born one afflicted with sorrow over the theft of the Vedas! / I will invoke the Ṛgveda, adorned with words.

3.22.s:
ṛgveda tvamihābhyehi brahmamūrte varaprada ..
ahamāvāhayiṣyāmi yajurvedamatipriyam .. 79 ..
3.22.d:
ऋग्वेद त्वमिहाभ्येहि ब्रह्ममूर्ते वरप्रद ॥
अहमावाहयिष्यामि यजुर्वेदमतिप्रियम् ॥ 79 ॥
3.22.m: Come here, Ṛgveda, form of Brahmā, giver of boons! / I will invoke the Yajurveda, exceedingly beloved.

3.22.s:
yajurveda tvamabhyehi deveśagaṇanāyaka ... .
ahamāvāhayiṣyāmi devamātharvaṇaṃ śubham .. 3.106.80 ..
3.22.d:
यजुर्वेद त्वमभ्येहि देवेशगणनायक ॥॥
अहमावाहयिष्यामि देवमाथर्वणं शुभम् ॥ 3.106.80 ॥
3.22.m: Come, O Yajurveda, leader of the hosts of the lord of the gods! / I shall invoke the auspicious Atharvaṇa god.

3.22.s:
āgacchātharvavedeha sarvakarmaphalaprada ..
devamāvāhayiṣyāmi bhogibhogāsanasthitam .. 81 ..
3.22.d:
आगच्छाथर्ववेदेह सर्वकर्मफलप्रद ॥
देवमावाहयिष्यामि भोगिभोगासनस्थितम् ॥ 81 ॥
3.22.m: Come here, O Atharvaveda, bestower of the fruit of all rites! / I shall invoke the god seated upon the coils of the serpent.

3.22.s:
bhogibhogāsanāsīna samāgaccha jagadguro ..
devamāvāhayiṣyāmi bhogibhogaśayaṃ prabhum .. 82 ..
3.22.d:
भोगिभोगासनासीन समागच्छ जगद्गुरो ॥
देवमावाहयिष्यामि भोगिभोगशयं प्रभुम् ॥ 82 ॥
3.22.m: Come, O teacher of the world, seated upon the coils of the serpent! / I shall invoke the lord who lies upon the coils of the serpent,

3.22.s:
lakṣmīsahāyaṃ varadaṃ lokasākṣiṇamavyayam ..
ehyehi puṇḍarīkākṣa bhogibhogāśayācyuta .. 83 ..
3.22.d:
लक्ष्मीसहायं वरदं लोकसाक्षिणमव्ययम् ॥
एह्येहि पुण्डरीकाक्ष भोगिभोगाशयाच्युत ॥ 83 ॥
3.22.m: Accompanied by Lakṣmī, boon-giver, witness of the world, imperishable! / Come, come, O lotus-eyed Acyuta, resting upon the coils of the serpent,

3.22.s:
trailokyanātha govinda madhukaiṭabhasūdana ..
devamāvāhayiṣyāmi viṣṇudevaṃ trivikramam .. 84 ....
3.22.d:
त्रैलोक्यनाथ गोविन्द मधुकैटभसूदन ॥
देवमावाहयिष्यामि विष्णुदेवं त्रिविक्रमम् ॥ 84 ॥॥
3.22.m: Lord of the three worlds, Govinda, slayer of Madhu and Kaiṭabha! / I shall invoke the god Viṣṇu as Trivikrama,

3.22.s:
samastabhuvanātīta pādākrāntajagattraya ..
trivikrama tvamabhyehi daityadīnākṣivīkṣita .. 85 ..
3.22.d:
समस्तभुवनातीत पादाक्रान्तजगत्त्रय ॥
त्रिविक्रम त्वमभ्येहि दैत्यदीनाक्षिवीक्षित ॥ 85 ॥
3.22.m: Who transcends all the worlds, who strode over the three worlds with his feet! / Come, O Trivikrama, beheld by the pitiable eyes of the Daityas,

3.22.s:
vikacotphullanayana tridaśaiḥ śatamīkṣita ..
ahamāvāhayiṣyāmi viśvarūpadharaṃ vibhum .. 86 ..
3.22.d:
विकचोत्फुल्लनयन त्रिदशैः शतमीक्षित ॥
अहमावाहयिष्यामि विश्वरूपधरं विभुम् ॥ 86 ॥
3.22.m: With wide open, blossoming eyes, gazed upon a hundred times by the gods! / I shall invoke the all-pervading lord who bears the universal form,

3.22.s:
śvasantamaniśaṃ vaktrairbhūtagrāmamaśeṣataḥ ..
sṛjaṃti ca mahārāja sarvabhūtānyanekaśaḥ .. 87 ..
3.22.d:
श्वसन्तमनिशं वक्त्रैर्भूतग्राममशेषतः ॥
सृजंति च महाराज सर्वभूतान्यनेकशः ॥ 87 ॥
3.22.m: Ceaselessly breathing forth the entire multitude of beings with his mouths, / And creating, O great king, all beings manifoldly,

3.22.s:
dhārayantaṃ śarīreṇa sarvaṃ jagadidaṃ tathā ..
viśvarūpa tvamabhyehi sarvāyudhavibhūṣita .. 88 ..
3.22.d:
धारयन्तं शरीरेण सर्वं जगदिदं तथा ॥
विश्वरूप त्वमभ्येहि सर्वायुधविभूषित ॥ 88 ॥
3.22.m: And likewise upholding this entire universe with his body! / Come, O Universal Form, adorned with all weapons,

3.22.s:
sarvabhūtena tātena nānāvarṇadharāpaha ..
dehasthāśeṣabhuvana jagatkāraṇakāraṇa..89..
3.22.d:
सर्वभूतेन तातेन नानावर्णधरापह ॥
देहस्थाशेषभुवन जगत्कारणकारण॥89॥
3.22.m: Constituting all beings, O father, dispelling [afflictions], bearing various colours, / Within whose body all worlds abide, cause of the cause of the world,

3.22.s:
durnirīkṣyātigambhīra māyādarśitavigraha ..
devamāvāhayiṣyāmi matsyaṃ salilagocaram..3.106.90..
3.22.d:
दुर्निरीक्ष्यातिगम्भीर मायादर्शितविग्रह ॥
देवमावाहयिष्यामि मत्स्यं सलिलगोचरम्॥3.106.90॥
3.22.m: Difficult to behold, exceedingly profound, whose form is displayed through māyā! / I shall invoke the god who moves in the waters, the Fish.

3.22.s:
matsyadeva tvamabhyehi lokajīvadharācyuta ..
haṃsamāvāhayiṣyāmi devaṃ jñānapradaṃ vibhum..91..
3.22.d:
मत्स्यदेव त्वमभ्येहि लोकजीवधराच्युत ॥
हंसमावाहयिष्यामि देवं ज्ञानप्रदं विभुम्॥91॥
3.22.m: Come, O divine Fish, Acyuta who preserves the life of the world! / I shall invoke the all-pervading divine Swan, bestower of knowledge.

3.22.s:
haṃsa śīghraṃ tvamabhyehi sarvajñānavināśana..
kūrmamāvāhayiṣyāmi dhṛtamandaraparvatam..92..
3.22.d:
हंस शीघ्रं त्वमभ्येहि सर्वज्ञानविनाशन॥
कूर्ममावाहयिष्यामि धृतमन्दरपर्वतम्॥92॥
3.22.m: Come quickly, O Swan, destroyer of all [ignorant] knowledge! / I shall invoke the Tortoise who bore Mount Mandara.

3.22.s:
ehyehi bhagavankūrma śyāmotpattikarācyuta ..
devamāvāhayiṣyāmi strīrūpaṃ dharmamīśvaram .. 93 ..
3.22.d:
एह्येहि भगवन्कूर्म श्यामोत्पत्तिकराच्युत ॥
देवमावाहयिष्यामि स्त्रीरूपं धर्ममीश्वरम् ॥ 93 ॥
3.22.m: Come, come, O blessed Tortoise, dark one, originator [of beings], Acyuta! / I shall invoke the sovereign god, dharma in the form of a woman.

3.22.s:
strīrūpadhārinnabhyehi surasomapradāyaka ..
naramāvāhayiṣyāmi devaṃ tapasi niṣṭhitam .. 94 ..
3.22.d:
स्त्रीरूपधारिन्नभ्येहि सुरसोमप्रदायक ॥
नरमावाहयिष्यामि देवं तपसि निष्ठितम् ॥ 94 ॥
3.22.m: Come, O bearer of a female form, who gave soma to the gods! / I shall invoke the god Nara, steadfast in asceticism.

3.22.s:
narābhyehi mahābhāga dharmamūrte jagatpate ..
devamāvāhayiṣyāmi tathā nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum .. 95 .
3.22.d:
नराभ्येहि महाभाग धर्ममूर्ते जगत्पते ॥
देवमावाहयिष्यामि तथा नारायणं प्रभुम् ॥ 95 ।
3.22.m: Come, O Nara, illustrious one, embodiment of dharma, lord of the world! / I shall likewise invoke the lord, the god Nārāyaṇa.

3.22.s:
nārāyaṇa samabhyehi sarvapāpaharāvyaya ..
harimāvāhayiṣyāmi deveśaṃ kanakaprabham .. 96 ..
3.22.d:
नारायण समभ्येहि सर्वपापहराव्यय ॥
हरिमावाहयिष्यामि देवेशं कनकप्रभम् ॥ 96 ॥
3.22.m: Come, O Nārāyaṇa, imperishable one, remover of all sins! / I shall invoke Hari, lord of the gods, radiant as gold.

3.22.s:
hare deva tvamabhyehi paradarpavināśaka ..
kṛṣṇamāvāhayiṣyāmi sajalāmbudasannibham .. 97 ..
3.22.d:
हरे देव त्वमभ्येहि परदर्पविनाशक ॥
कृष्णमावाहयिष्यामि सजलाम्बुदसन्निभम् ॥ 97 ॥
3.22.m: Come, O divine Hari, destroyer of the pride of foes! / I shall invoke Kṛṣṇa, resembling a water-laden cloud.

3.22.s:
kṛṣṇābhyehi mahābhāga devadeva jagatpriya ..
devamāvāhayiṣyāmi dattātreyaṃ taponvitam .. 98
3.22.d:
कृष्णाभ्येहि महाभाग देवदेव जगत्प्रिय ॥
देवमावाहयिष्यामि दत्तात्रेयं तपोन्वितम् ॥ 98
3.22.m: Come, O Kṛṣṇa, illustrious one, god of gods, beloved of the world! / I shall invoke the divine Dattātreya, endowed with asceticism.

3.22.s:
dattātreya tvamabhyehi vedoddharaṇatatpara ..
ahamāvāhayiṣyāmi vālmīkiṃ tapasāṃ nidhim .. 99 ..
3.22.d:
दत्तात्रेय त्वमभ्येहि वेदोद्धरणतत्पर ॥
अहमावाहयिष्यामि वाल्मीकिं तपसां निधिम् ॥ 99 ॥
3.22.m: Come, O Dattātreya, intent upon rescuing the Vedas! / I shall invoke Vālmīki, storehouse of asceticism.

3.22.s:
vālmīke tvamihābhyehi vedoddharaṇatatpara ..
rāmamāvāhayiṣyāmi hatakṣattriyamaṇḍalam .. 3.106.100 ..
3.22.d:
वाल्मीके त्वमिहाभ्येहि वेदोद्धरणतत्पर ॥
राममावाहयिष्यामि हतक्षत्त्रियमण्डलम् ॥ 3.106.100 ॥
3.22.m: Come here, O Vālmīki, intent upon rescuing the Vedas! / I shall invoke Rāma, who destroyed the host of kṣatriyas.

3.22.s:
bhāgarvābhyehi me nātha jaṭāmaṇḍaladurdṛśa ..
āvāhanaṃ kariṣyāmi paraśuṃ dīptatejasam .. 101 ..
3.22.d:
भागर्वाभ्येहि मे नाथ जटामण्डलदुर्दृश ॥
आवाहनं करिष्यामि परशुं दीप्ततेजसम् ॥ 101 ॥
3.22.m: Come, O Bhārgava, my lord, formidable with your circle of matted hair! / I shall perform the invocation of the Axe of blazing splendour.

3.22.s:
āgaccha paraśo śīghraṃ lakṣīkṛtavasundhara ..
pṛthumāvāhayiṣyāmi cakravartinamūrjitam .. 102 ..
3.22.d:
आगच्छ परशो शीघ्रं लक्षीकृतवसुन्धर ॥
पृथुमावाहयिष्यामि चक्रवर्तिनमूर्जितम् ॥ 102 ॥
3.22.m: Come quickly, O Axe, that made the earth your target! / I shall invoke Pṛthu, the mighty universal emperor.

3.22.s:
pṛtho śīghraṃ tvamabhyehi pṛthvīnātha mahābala ..
rāmamāvāhayiṣyāmi kṛtarākṣasanigraham .. 103 ..
3.22.d:
पृथो शीघ्रं त्वमभ्येहि पृथ्वीनाथ महाबल ॥
राममावाहयिष्यामि कृतराक्षसनिग्रहम् ॥ 103 ॥
3.22.m: Come quickly, O Pṛthu, lord of the earth, of great might! / I shall invoke Rāma, who subdued the rākṣasas.

3.22.s:
rāma śīghraṃ tvamabhyehi dharmaseto durāsada ..
ahamāvāhayiṣyāmi pradyumnaṃ bharataṃ vibhum .. 104 ..
3.22.d:
राम शीघ्रं त्वमभ्येहि धर्मसेतो दुरासद ॥
अहमावाहयिष्यामि प्रद्युम्नं भरतं विभुम् ॥ 104 ॥
3.22.m: Come quickly, O Rāma, bridge of dharma, unassailable one! / I shall invoke the all-pervading Bharata, who is Pradyumna.

3.22.s:
bharata tvamihābhyehi kṛtagandharvanigraha ..
ahamāvāhayiṣyāmi lakṣmaṇaṃ ripunāśanam .. 105 ..
3.22.d:
भरत त्वमिहाभ्येहि कृतगन्धर्वनिग्रह ॥
अहमावाहयिष्यामि लक्ष्मणं रिपुनाशनम् ॥ 105 ॥
3.22.m: Come here, O Bharata, who subdued the gandharvas! / I shall invoke Lakṣmaṇa, destroyer of foes.

3.22.s:
lakṣmaṇa tvamihābhyehi meghanādāstrabhāskara ..
ahamāvāhayiṣyāmi śatrughnaṃ dīptatejasam .. 106 ..
3.22.d:
लक्ष्मण त्वमिहाभ्येहि मेघनादास्त्रभास्कर ॥
अहमावाहयिष्यामि शत्रुघ्नं दीप्ततेजसम् ॥ 106 ॥
3.22.m: Come here, O Lakṣmaṇa, sun [drying up] the missile of Meghanāda! / I shall invoke Śatrughna of blazing splendour.

3.22.s:
śatrughna śīghramabhyehi lavaṇāsuramardana ..
vyāsamāvāhayiṣyāmi vedavyāsaṃ jagadgurum .. 107 ..
3.22.d:
शत्रुघ्न शीघ्रमभ्येहि लवणासुरमर्दन ॥
व्यासमावाहयिष्यामि वेदव्यासं जगद्गुरुम् ॥ 107 ॥
3.22.m: Come quickly, O Śatrughna, crusher of the asura Lavaṇa! / I shall invoke Vyāsa, Vedavyāsa, teacher of the world.

3.22.s:
vedavyāsa tvamabhyehi sarvadharmapradarśaka ..
ahamāvāhayiṣyāmi dharmaputraṃ yudhiṣṭhiram .. 108 ..
3.22.d:
वेदव्यास त्वमभ्येहि सर्वधर्मप्रदर्शक ॥
अहमावाहयिष्यामि धर्मपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम् ॥ 108 ॥
3.22.m: Come, O Vedavyāsa, revealer of all dharmas! / I shall invoke Yudhiṣṭhira, son of Dharma.

3.22.s:
yudhiṣṭhira tvamabhyehi sarvadharmabhṛtāṃvara ..
ahamāvāhayiṣyāmi bhīmaṃ mārutaputrakam .. 109 ..
3.22.d:
युधिष्ठिर त्वमभ्येहि सर्वधर्मभृतांवर ॥
अहमावाहयिष्यामि भीमं मारुतपुत्रकम् ॥ 109 ॥
3.22.m: Come, O Yudhiṣṭhira, foremost of all upholders of dharma! / I shall invoke Bhīma, son of the Wind.

3.22.s:
bhīmasena tvamabhyehi śatrunāśa tamohara ..
ahamāvāhayiṣyāmi pārthaṃ ripuniṣūdanam .. 3.106.110 ..
3.22.d:
भीमसेन त्वमभ्येहि शत्रुनाश तमोहर ॥
अहमावाहयिष्यामि पार्थं रिपुनिषूदनम् ॥ 3.106.110 ॥
3.22.m: Come, O Bhīmasena, destroyer of foes, dispeller of darkness! / I shall invoke Pārtha, slayer of enemies.

3.22.s:
arjunābhyehi me śīghraṃ laghvīkṛtavasundhara ..
ahamāvāhayiṣyāmi nakulaṃ rūpaśobhitam .. 111 ..
3.22.d:
अर्जुनाभ्येहि मे शीघ्रं लघ्वीकृतवसुन्धर ॥
अहमावाहयिष्यामि नकुलं रूपशोभितम् ॥ 111 ॥
3.22.m: Come quickly to me, O Arjuna, who lightened the burden of the earth! / I shall invoke Nakula, adorned with beauty.

3.22.s:
nakula tvamihābhyehi śaṅkhacarmmadharācyuta ..
ahamāvāhayiṣyāmi sahadevaṃ raṇapriyam .. 112 ..
3.22.d:
नकुल त्वमिहाभ्येहि शङ्खचर्म्मधराच्युत ॥
अहमावाहयिष्यामि सहदेवं रणप्रियम् ॥ 112 ॥
3.22.m: Come here, O Nakula, Acyuta who bears the conch and shield! / I shall invoke Sahadeva, who loves battle.

3.22.s:
sahadeva tvamabhyehi rūpadraviṇasaṃyuta ..
kṛṣṇāmāvāhayiṣyāmi svargalakṣmīṃ manoharām .. 113 ..
3.22.d:
सहदेव त्वमभ्येहि रूपद्रविणसंयुत ॥
कृष्णामावाहयिष्यामि स्वर्गलक्ष्मीं मनोहराम् ॥ 113 ॥
3.22.m: Come, O Sahadeva, endowed with beauty and wealth! / I shall invoke Kṛṣṇā, the captivating fortune of heaven.

3.22.s:
yājñaseni tvamabhyehi lakṣīkṛtavasundhare ..
sītāmāvāhayiṣyāmi rāmapatnīṃ yaśasvinīm .. 114 ..
3.22.d:
याज्ञसेनि त्वमभ्येहि लक्षीकृतवसुन्धरे ॥
सीतामावाहयिष्यामि रामपत्नीं यशस्विनीम् ॥ 114 ॥
3.22.m: Come, O Yājñasenī, who made the earth your aim! / I shall invoke Sītā, the renowned wife of Rāma.

3.22.s:
sīte devi tvamabhyehi mahītalasamukṣite ..
ahamāvāhayipyāmi devakīṃ kṛṣṇamātaram ..115..
3.22.d:
सीते देवि त्वमभ्येहि महीतलसमुक्षिते ॥
अहमावाहयिप्यामि देवकीं कृष्णमातरम् ॥115॥
3.22.m: Come, O divine Sītā, sprung from the surface of the earth! / I shall invoke Devakī, mother of Kṛṣṇa.

3.22.s:
devaki tvaṃ samabhyehi devamātarjagatpriye ..
ahamāvāhayiṣyāmi yaśodāṃ jagataḥ priyām ..116..
3.22.d:
देवकि त्वं समभ्येहि देवमातर्जगत्प्रिये ॥
अहमावाहयिष्यामि यशोदां जगतः प्रियाम् ॥116॥
3.22.m: Come, O Devakī, mother of the god, beloved of the world! / I shall invoke Yaśodā, dear to the world.

3.22.s:
yaśode tvamihābhyehi saṃvardhitajanārdane ..
devīmāvāhayiṣyāmi ekānāśīti viśrutām..117..
3.22.d:
यशोदे त्वमिहाभ्येहि संवर्धितजनार्दने ॥
देवीमावाहयिष्यामि एकानाशीति विश्रुताम्॥117॥
3.22.m: Come here, O Yaśodā, who nurtured Janārdana! / I shall invoke the goddess renowned as Ekānaṃśā.

3.22.s:
ekānāśe tvamabhyehi kṛṣṇarakṣārthamudyate ..
devīmāvāhayiṣyāmi rukmiṇīṃ kṛṣṇavallabhām .. 118 ..
3.22.d:
एकानाशे त्वमभ्येहि कृष्णरक्षार्थमुद्यते ॥
देवीमावाहयिष्यामि रुक्मिणीं कृष्णवल्लभाम् ॥ 118 ॥
3.22.m: Come, O Ekānaṃśā, intent on protecting Kṛṣṇa! / I shall invoke the goddess Rukmiṇī, beloved of Kṛṣṇa.

3.22.s:
rukmiṇi tvamihābhyehi jagatāmekasundari ..
devīmāvāhayiṣyāmi satyabhāmāṃ manoharām ..119 ..
3.22.d:
रुक्मिणि त्वमिहाभ्येहि जगतामेकसुन्दरि ॥
देवीमावाहयिष्यामि सत्यभामां मनोहराम् ॥119 ॥
3.22.m: Come here, O Rukmiṇī, peerless beauty of the worlds! / I shall invoke the captivating goddess Satyabhāmā.

3.22.s:
satyabhāme tvamabhyehi devi keśavavallabhe ..
devīstvāvāhayiṣyāmi kṛṣṇapatnīrahaṃ śubhāḥ ..3.106.120..
3.22.d:
सत्यभामे त्वमभ्येहि देवि केशववल्लभे ॥
देवीस्त्वावाहयिष्यामि कृष्णपत्नीरहं शुभाः ॥3.106.120॥
3.22.m: Come, O Satyabhāmā, O goddess beloved of Keśava! / I shall invoke the auspicious goddesses, the wives of Kṛṣṇa.

3.22.s:
devyaḥ sarvāḥ samāyāntu gāndhārīpramukhāstviha ..
rāmamāvāhayiṣyāmi madavibhrāntalocanam .. 321 ..
3.22.d:
देव्यः सर्वाः समायान्तु गान्धारीप्रमुखास्त्विह ॥
राममावाहयिष्यामि मदविभ्रान्तलोचनम् ॥ 321 ॥
3.22.m: Let all the goddesses headed by Gāndhārī come here! / I shall invoke Rāma, whose eyes roll with intoxication,

3.22.s:
kuṇḍalaikadharaṃ śāntaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam ..
ehi rāma mahābhāga revatīdayitācyuta ..122..
3.22.d:
कुण्डलैकधरं शान्तं वनमालाविभूषितम् ॥
एहि राम महाभाग रेवतीदयिताच्युत ॥122॥
3.22.m: Wearing a single earring, tranquil, adorned with a woodland garland! / Come, O Rāma, illustrious one, beloved of Revatī, Acyuta,

3.22.s:
hatapralambasīrāgravyākṛṣṭayamunodaka ..
kṛṣṇamāvāhayiṣyāmi toyapūrṇāmbudacchavim .. 123 ..
3.22.d:
हतप्रलम्बसीराग्रव्याकृष्टयमुनोदक ॥
कृष्णमावाहयिष्यामि तोयपूर्णाम्बुदच्छविम् ॥ 123 ॥
3.22.m: Slayer of Pralamba, who dragged the water of the Yamunā with the tip of his plow! / I shall invoke Kṛṣṇa, of the complexion of a water-filled cloud,

3.22.s:
cāṇūrabaladarpaghnaṃ kaṃsāsuravināśanam ..
ehi kṛṣṇa mahābhāga lakṣīkṛtavasundhara .. 124 ..
3.22.d:
चाणूरबलदर्पघ्नं कंसासुरविनाशनम् ॥
एहि कृष्ण महाभाग लक्षीकृतवसुन्धर ॥ 124 ॥
3.22.m: Who broke the pride of Cāṇūra's strength, destroyer of the asura Kaṃsa! / Come, O Kṛṣṇa, illustrious one, who took the earth as your target,

3.22.s:
nirastadānavaśreṣṭha dhṛtagovardhanācala ..
ahamāvāhayiṣyāmi pradyumnaṃ makaracchavim .. 125 ..
3.22.d:
निरस्तदानवश्रेष्ठ धृतगोवर्धनाचल ॥
अहमावाहयिष्यामि प्रद्युम्नं मकरच्छविम् ॥ 125 ॥
3.22.m: Who cast down the foremost of Dānavas, who held Mount Govardhana! / I shall invoke Pradyumna, who bears the sign of the sea-monster,

3.22.s:
devāriśambaraprāṇataskaraṃ rativallabham ..
pradyumna tvamihābhyehi parasainyavināśana .. 126 ..
3.22.d:
देवारिशम्बरप्राणतस्करं रतिवल्लभम् ॥
प्रद्युम्न त्वमिहाभ्येहि परसैन्यविनाशन ॥ 126 ॥
3.22.m: Who stole the life of Śambara, the enemy of the gods, beloved of Rati! / Come here, O Pradyumna, destroyer of the armies of foes!

3.22.s:
ahamāvāhayiṣyāmi aniruddhaṃ jagadgurum..
bāṇāsuramahāsainyasamudra vaḍavānala .. 127 ..
3.22.d:
अहमावाहयिष्यामि अनिरुद्धं जगद्गुरुम्॥
बाणासुरमहासैन्यसमुद्र वडवानल ॥ 127 ॥
3.22.m: I shall invoke Aniruddha, the teacher of the world, / a submarine fire to the ocean of the great army of the demon Bāṇa.

3.22.s:
aniruddha tvamabhyehi mahābalaparākrama ..
khaḍgapāṇe mahābhāga ūṣāhṛdayavarddhana .. 338..
3.22.d:
अनिरुद्ध त्वमभ्येहि महाबलपराक्रम ॥
खड्गपाणे महाभाग ऊषाहृदयवर्द्धन ॥ 338॥
3.22.m: Come, Aniruddha of great strength and valour, / sword in hand, highly fortunate one, who gladdened the heart of Ūṣā!

3.22.s:
sāmbamāvāhayiṣyāmi gadāpāṇiṃ mahābalam ..
ehi sāmba mahābhāga nāśitāśeṣadānava .. 129 ..
3.22.d:
साम्बमावाहयिष्यामि गदापाणिं महाबलम् ॥
एहि साम्ब महाभाग नाशिताशेषदानव ॥ 129 ॥
3.22.m: I shall invoke Sāmba, club in hand, of great strength. / Come, highly fortunate Sāmba, destroyer of all the Dānavas!

3.22.s:
ahamāvāhayiṣyāmi yuyudhānaṃ balotkaṭam ..
yuyudhāna tvamabhyehi dīrghabāho'rimardana .. 3.106.130 ..
3.22.d:
अहमावाहयिष्यामि युयुधानं बलोत्कटम् ॥
युयुधान त्वमभ्येहि दीर्घबाहोऽरिमर्दन ॥ 3.106.130 ॥
3.22.m: I shall invoke Yuyudhāna, eminent in strength. / Come, Yuyudhāna of long arms, crusher of foes!

3.22.s:
ahamāvāhayiṣyāmi saubhadramaparājitam ..
vasubhadraṃ ca dharmajñaṃ nīlāmbaradharāvubhau .. 131 ..
3.22.d:
अहमावाहयिष्यामि सौभद्रमपराजितम् ॥
वसुभद्रं च धर्मज्ञं नीलाम्बरधरावुभौ ॥ 131 ॥
3.22.m: I shall invoke the son of Subhadrā, undefeated, / and Vasubhadra, knower of dharma, both wearing dark-blue garments,

3.22.s:
vāsudevapratīhārau prāptahastau sulocanau ..
taptajāmbūnadākārau mahābalaparākramau .. 132 ..
3.22.d:
वासुदेवप्रतीहारौ प्राप्तहस्तौ सुलोचनौ ॥
तप्तजाम्बूनदाकारौ महाबलपराक्रमौ ॥ 132 ॥
3.22.m: the two doorkeepers of Vāsudeva, with hands joined, beautiful-eyed, / having the appearance of molten gold, possessing great strength and valour.

3.22.s:
subhadra śīghramāgaccha pūrvadvārasya vāmataḥ ..
gaṇaiḥ sānucaraiḥ sārddhaṃ bhava sannihitaḥ sadā .. 133 ..
3.22.d:
सुभद्र शीघ्रमागच्छ पूर्वद्वारस्य वामतः ॥
गणैः सानुचरैः सार्द्धं भव सन्निहितः सदा ॥ 133 ॥
3.22.m: O Subhadra, come quickly to the left of the eastern gate; / together with your hosts and attendants, be ever present!

3.22.s:
ahamāvāhayiṣyāmi tathāṣāḍhaṃ balānvitam ..
yajñatātaṃ ca dharmajñaṃ pītāmbaradharāvubhau .. 134 ..
3.22.d:
अहमावाहयिष्यामि तथाषाढं बलान्वितम् ॥
यज्ञतातं च धर्मज्ञं पीताम्बरधरावुभौ ॥ 134 ॥
3.22.m: I shall also invoke Āṣāḍha, endowed with strength, / and Yajñatāta, knower of dharma, both wearing yellow garments,

3.22.s:
nīlajīmūtasaṅkāśau tathā mudgaradhāriṇau ..
saṅkarṣaṇapratīhārau cārurūpau manoharau .. 135 ..
3.22.d:
नीलजीमूतसङ्काशौ तथा मुद्गरधारिणौ ॥
सङ्कर्षणप्रतीहारौ चारुरूपौ मनोहरौ ॥ 135 ॥
3.22.m: resembling dark-blue rainclouds and bearing mallets, / the two doorkeepers of Saṃkarṣaṇa, charming of form and captivating.

3.22.s:
āṣāḍha tvamihāgaccha dakṣiṇadvāravāmataḥ ..
gaṇaiḥ sānucaraiḥ sārdhaṃ bhava sannihitaḥ sadā .. 136 ..
3.22.d:
आषाढ त्वमिहागच्छ दक्षिणद्वारवामतः ॥
गणैः सानुचरैः सार्धं भव सन्निहितः सदा ॥ 136 ॥
3.22.m: O Āṣāḍha, come here to the left of the southern gate; / together with your hosts and attendants, be ever present!

3.22.s:
yajñatāta tvamabhyehi dvāradakṣiṇato bhava ..
gaṇaiḥ sānucaraiḥ sārdhaṃ bhava sannihitaḥ sadā .. 137 ..
3.22.d:
यज्ञतात त्वमभ्येहि द्वारदक्षिणतो भव ॥
गणैः सानुचरैः सार्धं भव सन्निहितः सदा ॥ 137 ॥
3.22.m: O Yajñatāta, approach and stay to the right of the gate; / together with your hosts and attendants, be ever present!

3.22.s:
( jayamāvāhayiṣyāmi dīptatejasamacyutam ..
vijayaṃ ca viśālaṃ ca pāṭalāmbaradhāriṇau .. 138 ..
3.22.d:
( जयमावाहयिष्यामि दीप्ततेजसमच्युतम् ॥
विजयं च विशालं च पाटलाम्बरधारिणौ ॥ 138 ॥
3.22.m: (I shall invoke Jaya of blazing splendour, the unfailing, / and Vijaya and Viśāla, both wearing rose-red garments,

3.22.s:
śaśāṃkāṃśupratīkāśau tathobhau khaḍgadhāriṇau ..)
pradyumnasya pratīhārau kāmadevau suvarcasau .. 139 ..
3.22.d:
शशांकांशुप्रतीकाशौ तथोभौ खड्गधारिणौ ॥)
प्रद्युम्नस्य प्रतीहारौ कामदेवौ सुवर्चसौ ॥ 139 ॥
3.22.m: resembling the rays of the moon and both bearing swords,) / the two doorkeepers of Pradyumna, godlike in form and of great radiance.

3.22.s:
jaya śīghraṃ tvamabhyehi paścimadvāravāmataḥ ..
gaṇaiḥ sānucaraiḥ sārdhaṃ bhava saṃnihitaḥ sadā .. 3.106.140 ..
3.22.d:
जय शीघ्रं त्वमभ्येहि पश्चिमद्वारवामतः ॥
गणैः सानुचरैः सार्धं भव संनिहितः सदा ॥ 3.106.140 ॥
3.22.m: O Jaya, approach quickly to the left of the western gate; / together with your hosts and attendants, be ever present!

3.22.s:
vijaya tvamihābhyehi dvāradakṣiṇato bhava ..
gaṇaiḥ sānucaraiḥ sārdhaṃ bhava sannihitaḥ sadā .. 141 ..
3.22.d:
विजय त्वमिहाभ्येहि द्वारदक्षिणतो भव ॥
गणैः सानुचरैः सार्धं भव सन्निहितः सदा ॥ 141 ॥
3.22.m: O Vijaya, approach here and stay to the right of the gate; / together with your hosts and attendants, be ever present!

3.22.s:
ahamāvāhayiṣyāmi tathā modaṃ jagatpriyam ..
pramodaṃ ca mahāvīryaṃ śvetāmbaradharāvubhau .. 142 ..
3.22.d:
अहमावाहयिष्यामि तथा मोदं जगत्प्रियम् ॥
प्रमोदं च महावीर्यं श्वेताम्बरधरावुभौ ॥ 142 ॥
3.22.m: I shall also invoke Moda, beloved of the world, / and Pramoda of great valour, both wearing white garments,

3.22.s:
sindūrāruṇasaṅkāśau śaktihastau balotkaṭau ..
aniruddhapratīhārau mahābalaparākramau .. 143 ..
3.22.d:
सिन्दूरारुणसङ्काशौ शक्तिहस्तौ बलोत्कटौ ॥
अनिरुद्धप्रतीहारौ महाबलपराक्रमौ ॥ 143 ॥
3.22.m: resembling the vermilion dawn, holding spears in hand, eminent in strength, / the two doorkeepers of Aniruddha, possessing great strength and valour.

3.22.s:
āmoda śīghramabhyehi dvāradakṣiṇato bhava ..
gaṇaiḥ sānucaraiḥ sārdhaṃ bhava sannihitaḥ sadā .. 144 ..
3.22.d:
आमोद शीघ्रमभ्येहि द्वारदक्षिणतो भव ॥
गणैः सानुचरैः सार्धं भव सन्निहितः सदा ॥ 144 ॥
3.22.m: O Āmoda, approach quickly and stay to the right of the gate; / together with your hosts and attendants, be ever present!

3.22.s:
sarvānāvāhayiṣyāmi vāsudevagaṇānaham ..
vāsudevasamākārānvāsudevaparākramān .. 145 ..
3.22.d:
सर्वानावाहयिष्यामि वासुदेवगणानहम् ॥
वासुदेवसमाकारान्वासुदेवपराक्रमान् ॥ 145 ॥
3.22.m: I shall invoke all the hosts of Vāsudeva, / who have forms like Vāsudeva and valour like Vāsudeva.

3.22.s:
pradyumnasya samākārānpradyumnābhaparākramān ..
pradyumnasya gaṇāḥ śīghramāyāṃtu bhuvaneśvarāḥ .. 146 ..
3.22.d:
प्रद्युम्नस्य समाकारान्प्रद्युम्नाभपराक्रमान् ॥
प्रद्युम्नस्य गणाः शीघ्रमायांतु भुवनेश्वराः ॥ 146 ॥
3.22.m: Having forms like Pradyumna and valour resembling Pradyumna's, / let the hosts of Pradyumna, lords of the worlds, come quickly,

3.22.s:
sarvakāmapradā vīrā sarveśāḥ sarvaśaktayaḥ ..
sarvānāvāhayiṣyāmi aniruddhagaṇānaham .. 147 ..
3.22.d:
सर्वकामप्रदा वीरा सर्वेशाः सर्वशक्तयः ॥
सर्वानावाहयिष्यामि अनिरुद्धगणानहम् ॥ 147 ॥
3.22.m: heroes who grant all desires, rulers of all, possessing all powers! / I shall invoke all the hosts of Aniruddha,

3.22.s:
aniruddhasamākārānaniruddhaparākramān ..
aniruddhagaṇāḥ śīghramāyāntu bhuvaneśvarāḥ .. 148 ..
3.22.d:
अनिरुद्धसमाकाराननिरुद्धपराक्रमान् ॥
अनिरुद्धगणाः शीघ्रमायान्तु भुवनेश्वराः ॥ 148 ॥
3.22.m: who have forms like Aniruddha and valour like Aniruddha; / let the hosts of Aniruddha, lords of the worlds, come quickly,

3.22.s:
sarvakāmapradā vīrā sarveśāḥ sarvaśaktayaḥ ..
prādurbhāvagatasyeva viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ .. 149 ..
3.22.d:
सर्वकामप्रदा वीरा सर्वेशाः सर्वशक्तयः ॥
प्रादुर्भावगतस्येव विष्णोरमिततेजसः ॥ 149 ॥
3.22.m: heroes who grant all desires, rulers of all, possessing all powers! / And for [any other] manifestation of Viṣṇu of immeasurable splendour,

3.22.s:
noktamāvāhanaṃ yatra vāsudevoktamañjasā ..
kāryamāvāhanaṃ tatra sarvagasya mahātmanaḥ ..
atha vā viṣṇurūpoktametatsāraṃ taveritam ..3.106.150 ..
3.22.d:
नोक्तमावाहनं यत्र वासुदेवोक्तमञ्जसा ॥
कार्यमावाहनं तत्र सर्वगस्य महात्मनः ॥
अथ वा विष्णुरूपोक्तमेतत्सारं तवेरितम् ॥3.106.150 ॥
3.22.m: where an invocation is not expressly stated, the invocation taught for Vāsudeva / is to be performed there for that all-pervading Great Self; / or else [the invocation] taught for the form of Viṣṇu [may be used]. This essential truth has been declared to you.

3.22.s:
āvāhane ye kathitāstu mantrā jñeyāsta eveha vibodhane'pi ..
āvāhane tatra vibodhane tu budhaiḥ prayojyaṃ yaduvaṃśanātha.. 151 ..
3.107
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
prokto vibodhane vīra maṃtro hi na divaukasām ..
vāsudevasya vakṣyāmi tava rājannibodhanam .. 1 ..
devaṃ vibodhayiṣyāmi vāsudevamajaṃ vibhum ..
anādimadhyaparyantaṃ mahābalaparākramam .. 2 ..
anantaṃ sarvagaṃ nāthaṃ mahadbhyopi mahattaram ..
sūkṣmātisūkṣmaṃ dūrasthaṃ sannikarṣagataṃ tathā .. 3 ..
nārāyaṇaṃ mṛdukaraṃ devaṃ śārṅgadhanurdharam ..
atasīkusumaśyāmaṃ pītavāsasamacyutam .. 4 ..
vibuddhaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ śaraṇāgatavatsalaḥ ..
saṃsārasarasīmagnabhagnanāgakṛtakṛpa .. 5 ..
cakraparyantacchinnāgra duḥsvapnagrāhadurdhara ..
saṃsevitamahāyoganidrāsammīlitekṣaṇa .. 6 ..
3.22.d:
आवाहने ये कथितास्तु मन्त्रा ज्ञेयास्त एवेह विबोधनेऽपि ॥
आवाहने तत्र विबोधने तु बुधैः प्रयोज्यं यदुवंशनाथ॥ 151 ॥
3.107
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
प्रोक्तो विबोधने वीर मंत्रो हि न दिवौकसाम् ॥
वासुदेवस्य वक्ष्यामि तव राजन्निबोधनम् ॥ 1 ॥
देवं विबोधयिष्यामि वासुदेवमजं विभुम् ॥
अनादिमध्यपर्यन्तं महाबलपराक्रमम् ॥ 2 ॥
अनन्तं सर्वगं नाथं महद्भ्योपि महत्तरम् ॥
सूक्ष्मातिसूक्ष्मं दूरस्थं सन्निकर्षगतं तथा ॥ 3 ॥
नारायणं मृदुकरं देवं शार्ङ्गधनुर्धरम् ॥
अतसीकुसुमश्यामं पीतवाससमच्युतम् ॥ 4 ॥
विबुद्धः पुण्डरीकाक्षः शरणागतवत्सलः ॥
संसारसरसीमग्नभग्ननागकृतकृप ॥ 5 ॥
चक्रपर्यन्तच्छिन्नाग्र दुःस्वप्नग्राहदुर्धर ॥
संसेवितमहायोगनिद्रासम्मीलितेक्षण ॥ 6 ॥
3.22.m:
The mantras that have been stated for invocation are to be known as the very same in awakening; / for invocation and for awakening, they should be employed by the wise, O lord of Yadu's lineage.
3.107
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
O hero, a mantra for awakening was indeed not declared for the gods; / I shall proclaim to you, O king, the awakening of Vāsudeva.
I shall awaken the lord, the unborn, all-pervading Vāsudeva, / who has no beginning, middle, or end, endowed with great strength and valour,
endless, all-pervading, the protector, greater than the great, / subtler than the subtlest, far away yet close at hand,
Nārāyaṇa of gentle hand, the god who bears the bow Śārṅga, / dark as the atasī flower, clad in yellow garments, the infallible one.
[Awake!] The lotus-eyed one is awakened, he who is tender toward those who take refuge in him! / O you who showed mercy to the broken elephant plunged in the lake of worldly existence!
O you who severed the snout of the crocodile of bad dreams with the rim of your discus, unassailable one! / O you whose eyes were closed in deep meditation through the great yogic sleep you resorted to!

तेषां स्वलोकगमनदत्तहस्तावलम्बन ॥
संसारसागरोत्तारमहापोत जनार्दन ॥ 3.107.10 ॥
नामग्रहणमात्रेण घनावक्षयकारक ॥
स्वतिमात्रकृताशेष मनोरथमहाफल ॥ 11 ॥
त्रिविक्रमक्रमाक्रान्तब्रह्माण्डोत्तरमण्डप ॥
बालेन्दुकल्पदंष्ट्राग्र लीलोद्धृतवसुन्धर ॥ 12 ॥
एते विबोधयन्ति त्वां देवाः सेन्द्रपुरोगमाः ॥
ऋषयश्च महाभागाः त्रैलोक्यामलदर्शिनः ॥ 13 ॥
विबोधयति देव त्वां ब्रह्मा शुभचतुर्मुखः ॥
यजुर्वेदो गदाभिस्तु गीर्भिदेववराच्युत ॥ 14 ॥
3.22.m:
O unfailing one, whose spacious couch extends along the coils of the serpent Śeṣa! / O you who have an upper canopy formed by the rays of the gems in his rows of hoods!
O you who shine with both lotus feet being massaged by Lakṣmī! / O you who destroyed the great Daityas and secured the safety of the three worlds!
O unfailing one, who sleep upon the ocean of milk gleaming like a web of cool moonbeams! / O destroyer of the fear of falling into the pits of hell for your devotees!
O you who offer a supporting hand to them for journeying to your own world! / O great ship for crossing the ocean of worldly existence, O Janārdana!
O you who bring about the destruction of dense [sins] merely by the utterance of your name! / O you whose praise alone yields the great fruit of all desires!
O you whose strides as Trivikrama overstepped the upper pavilion of the cosmic egg! / O you who lifted up the earth in sport with the tip of your tusk that resembled the crescent moon!
These gods, led by Indra, are awakening you, / as well as the highly fortunate sages whose vision of the three worlds is stainless.
The god Brahmā of auspicious four faces is awakening you, / and the Yajurveda with its verses of praise, O best of gods, O unfailing one!

3.22.d:
त्यज विबुधगणारिसूदनाद्य निद्रां भव भुवनपतेघसंचयापहो मे ॥
त्वयि भवति हि यस्य नाथ भक्तिरुग्रा गतिरतिशयनी तु तस्य दैवतेभ्यः ॥ 15 ॥
3.108
॥ वव्र उवाच ॥ ॥
भगवन्सर्वदेवानां मूर्तयः परिकीर्तिताः ॥
पञ्चभूतयुता यस्मात्तस्मात्तेषां भृगूत्तम ॥ 1 ॥
आवाहनविधिःप्रोक्तो यत्तद्युक्ततमं मतम् ॥
आवाहिताः समायान्ति यत्र कामावसायिताम् ॥ 2 ॥
आश्रित्य महिमां प्राप्तिं लघिमां च तथा सुराः ॥
विष्णुः सर्वगतो देवो महद्भ्योपि महत्तरः ॥ 3 ॥
सूक्ष्मेभ्यश्चातिसूक्ष्मश्च सर्वव्यापी जगन्मयः ॥
नास्ति किञ्चिज्जगत्यस्मिन्यत्र नास्ति जनार्दनः ॥ 4 ॥
सदसच्च महाभाग तेन व्याप्तं महात्मना ॥
आवाहनेन किं कार्यं तस्य सर्वगतस्य तु ॥ 5 ॥
महेंद्रिय महाभाग सर्वत्र परिपच्यते ॥
एतन्मे संशयं छिन्धि त्वं हि सर्वविदुच्यसे ॥ 6 ॥
3.22.m:
Cast off sleep today, O slayer of the enemies of the hosts of gods; be the remover of the accumulation of my sins, O lord of the world! / For he who has intense devotion to you, O lord, attains a state that surpasses even that of the gods.
3.108
Vajra said:
O blessed one, the bodily forms of all the gods have been proclaimed; / because they consist of the five gross elements, therefore for them, O foremost of the Bhṛgus,
the rule of invocation has been declared, which is considered most proper; / where, when invoked, they attain the fulfilment of desires.
[The gods come,] resorting to magnitude, attainment, and lightness, O gods. / Viṣṇu is the all-pervading god, greater than even the great,
subtler than the subtle, all-pervading, and composed of the universe. / There is nothing in this universe where Janārdana is not.
The real and the unreal, O fortunate one, are pervaded by that Great Soul. / What is the use of invocation for him who is all-pervading?
[He who is beyond] the great senses, O fortunate one, is experienced everywhere. / Dispel this doubt of mine, for you are called omniscient.

3.22.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
सर्वदेवगणा यद्वद्वज्र पिण्डितमूर्तयः ॥
प्रादुर्भावगतोप्येवं देवो मधुनिषूदनः ॥ 7 ॥
पञ्चभूतयुता मूर्तिः सर्वा भवति मण्डिता ॥
आद्यन्तमध्यसंयुक्ता सर्वस्यैव यदूत्तम॥8॥
प्रादुर्भावगतो विष्णुर्यथा देवगणास्तथा ॥
आहितः सन्निहितो भवतीति विनिश्चयः ॥9 ॥
देवस्य द्विविधा मूर्तिः परा चैव तथापरा ॥
परायाः पौरुषी मूर्तिः पञ्चभूतविराजिता ॥ 3.108.10 ॥
तया समूर्तिर्भवति सर्वगः परमेश्वरः ॥
पुरुषेण विना लोके न किञ्चिदिह विद्यते ॥ 11 ॥
अनादिमध्यनिधनस्त्वप्रमेयतनुस्तथा ॥
सर्वेन्द्रियमनाः शक्तिः सर्वतः स तथा नृप ॥12॥
प्रादुर्भावगतस्यापि तस्य या सर्वशक्तिता ॥
इच्छतः सा विनिर्दिष्टा न त्वेषानिच्छतो नृप ॥ 13 ॥
पुरुषत्वे ह्यनन्तस्य या राजन्सर्वशक्तिता ॥
निसर्गसिद्धा सा ज्ञेया सदा सर्वत्र यादव ॥ ॥ 14 ॥
3.22.m:
Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Just as all the hosts of gods, O Vajra, possess condensed forms, / even so is the god, the slayer of Madhu, when he has assumed a manifestation.
Every form endowed with the five elements becomes adorned, / joined with beginning, end, and middle for everything, O best of Yadus.
Just as the hosts of gods, so too Viṣṇu, having assumed a manifestation, / being invoked, becomes present: this is the certain conclusion.
Twofold is the form of the god: higher and lower. / The form of the higher is of the Cosmic Person, shining with the five elements;
by it, the all-pervading Supreme Lord possesses a form. / Without the Cosmic Person, nothing whatsoever exists here in the world.
He is without beginning, middle, or end, and of immeasurable body; / he is power, mind, and all senses in every direction, O king.
That omnipotence of his, even when he has assumed a manifestation, / is declared to be [present] when he wills it, but not when he does not will it, O king.
Indeed, in the state of the Cosmic Person, that omnipotence of the Infinite One, O king, / should be known as naturally accomplished, always and everywhere, O Yādava.

3.22.d:
आवाहनमथात्रापि क्रियते यज्जगत्पतेः ॥
नित्यं संनिहितस्यापि सर्वत्र परमेष्ठिनः ॥ 15 ॥
केवलं कारणं तत्र मनसस्तुष्टिकारणम् ॥
आवाहितो मया देवः स्थाने सन्निहितोऽपि च ॥ 16 ॥
आवाहनं स्वतृप्त्यर्थं पुरुषस्य यथा स्थितम् ॥
तथाप्यर्चा महाभाग स्वतुष्ट्यर्थं प्रयोजनम् ॥ 17 ॥
नित्यतृप्तस्य किं तस्य कार्यं भवति चार्चया ॥ 18 ॥
केवलं भक्तितुष्ट्यर्थं स भक्तेभ्यः प्रतीच्छति ॥
योसावर्चयते देवो यत्र देवोर्च्यते बुधैः ॥ 19 ॥
अभ्यर्चते च यैर्भावैः सर्वे तद्विद्धि तन्मयम् ॥
तस्यार्चाकरणं विद्धि कर्तृप्रीतिप्रयोजनम् ॥ 3.108.20 ॥
ज्ञेयं तथैव चात्मानं तस्य सर्वगतस्य तु॥
अनादिकारणं तेन नित्यतृप्तेन यादव ॥ 21 ॥
अनुग्रहार्थं भक्तानां चात्मनः संप्रवर्तितम् ॥
अशरीरः शरीरस्थो यथा भवति भूपते ॥ 22 ॥
3.22.m:
Moreover, as to the invocation of the Lord of the world that is performed here, / even of Parameṣṭhin who is eternally present everywhere,
the sole reason there is to cause satisfaction to the mind: / 'The god has been invoked by me in this place, even though he was already present.'
Just as invocation exists for the self-satisfaction of the person, / even so, O fortunate one, the worship has self-satisfaction as its purpose.
For him who is eternally satisfied, what purpose does he have with worship?
Only to satisfy devotion does he accept [it] from his devotees. / That god who is worshipped, where the god is worshipped by the wise,
and with whatever dispositions one worships—know that all that is identical with him. / Know that the performance of his worship has as its purpose the pleasure of the performer.
Likewise, the self of that all-pervading one should be known. / By that causeless, eternally satisfied one, O Yādava,
[this] was set in motion for the grace of devotees and of himself, / so that, though bodiless, he abides in a body, O lord of the earth.

3.22.d:
भक्तलक्षणबोधार्थं तथैवावाह्यते त्वसौ ॥
अनाकारं महाराज लक्ष्यबन्धस्तु दुष्करः॥23॥
साकारैर्लक्षबन्धस्तु कर्तुं वै शक्यते सुखम्॥
विधिवच्च तथाकारः प्रादुर्भावगतस्य हि॥24॥
मयोक्तो राजशार्दूल पुरस्तादेव शास्त्रतः ॥
भावो भवतु यो यस्मिन्भावनायां भवेन्नरः ॥ 25 ॥
तत्रैव भावनानेन कार्या चार्चा च यादव ॥
आदौ कृत्वा महाभाग साकारे लक्षबन्धनम् ॥ 26 ॥
ततः समर्थो भवति शून्ये ध्याने नरोत्तम॥
एवमावाहनं तस्य तथा पूजा च यादव ॥ 27 ॥
प्रबुद्धैः क्रियते यत्नादात्मानुग्रहकारणम् ॥
नित्यतृप्तो न तृप्त्यर्थमुपहारं प्रयच्छति ॥ 28 ॥
प्रतीच्छति महाराज भक्तानुग्रहकारकः ॥
मोक्ष प्राप्तावुभावेतौ त्वया ज्ञेयौ महाभुज ॥ 29 ॥
3.22.m:
Indeed, he is invoked precisely for the comprehension of the mark of devotion. / For the formless, O great king, fixing the target is difficult.
Fixing the target can indeed be easily done with forms; / and the form of one who has assumed a manifestation, according to rule,
has been described by me earlier, O tiger among kings, according to the treatise. / Whatever disposition a man may have in contemplation,
with that very [disposition] contemplation and worship should be performed by him, O Yādava. / Having first fixed the target on a form, O fortunate one,
he then becomes capable of meditation on the void, O best of men. / Thus his invocation and likewise his worship, O Yādava,
is performed with effort by the awakened for the sake of grace upon themselves. / The eternally satisfied one does not offer a presentation for the sake of his own satisfaction;
he accepts [it], O great king, as one who bestows grace upon his devotees. / Both of these should be known by you as leading to the attainment of liberation, O mighty-armed one:

3.22.m:
3.109
Vajra said:
O blessed one, tell [me] the rule for the fire-offering.
The blessed Mārkaṇḍeya said to him:
The Blessed One having been ritually inhabited, [the priest], having kindled the fire, swept around it, and offered melted clarified butter with festivity between the portions of ghee [accompanied by] the demon-destroying mantras as stated before, should offer eight, twenty-eight, or one hundred and eight oblations of ghee, or barley, sesame, and white mustard seeds, with the names about to be spoken, ending in 'svāhā' and employed in the dative case, one by one with each name:
'Oṃ, homage to the Blessed One, Vāsudeva!'
'Oṃ, homage to the Blessed One, Saṃkarṣaṇa!'
'Oṃ, homage to the Blessed One, Pradyumna!'
'Oṃ, homage to the Blessed One, Aniruddha!'
'Oṃ, homage to the Blessed One, the Cosmic Person!'
'Oṃ, homage to the Blessed One, Satya!'
'Oṃ, homage to the Blessed One, Acyuta!'
'Oṃ, homage to Śrī!'
'Oṃ, homage to Kālarātri!'
'Oṃ, homage to Sṛṣṭi!'
'Oṃ, homage to Garuḍa!'
'Oṃ, homage to Tāla!'
'Oṃ, homage to Makara!'
'Oṃ, homage to Ṛṣya!'
'Oṃ, homage to Ananta!'
'Oṃ, homage to the Kaustubha!'
'Oṃ, homage to the forest-garland!'
'Oṃ, homage to the Earth!'
'Oṃ, homage to the conch!'
'Oṃ, homage to the lotus!'
'Oṃ, homage to the mace!'
'Oṃ, homage to the discus!'
'Oṃ, homage to the plough!'
'Oṃ, homage to the pestle!'
'Oṃ, homage to the bow!'
'Oṃ, homage to the shield!'
'Oṃ, homage to the sword!'
'Oṃ, homage to Subhadra!'
'Oṃ, homage to Vasubhadra!'
'Oṃ, homage to Āṣāḍha!'
'Oṃ, homage to Yajñatāta!'
'Oṃ, homage to Jaya!'
'Oṃ, homage to Vijaya!'
'Oṃ, homage to Āmoda!'
'Oṃ, homage to Pramoda!'
Then the offering with the sacred utterances should be performed.
Then he should perform the offering with the Gāyatrī.
Then with this [verse]: 'That highest step of Viṣṇu'; then with the Vaiṣṇava Gāyatrī.
Then with the section beginning 'They yoke the mind'.
Then with the Puruṣasūkta.
Then with the four verses beginning 'The chariot among the dice'.
Then with the six [verses] of the Camaka.
Then with clarified butter.
He should complete the subsequent rite with the actions preceded by the fire-offering to the Year, the gods, and so forth.
This fire-offering is proclaimed for the consecration of Viṣṇu;
and for other deities, he should offer the oblation with [mantras containing] their specific marks.

मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
अथ प्रतिष्ठादिदिवसे प्राप्ते शङ्खपटहतूर्यैः श्रीभगवन्तं विबोधयेत् ॥

ततः कल्पकोटिमूर्तिधरोर्ध्वबाहुः कलशधरस्थपतिश्चात्र भगवान् यश्चेह भगवानिति मन्त्रेण देवागारं प्रविशेयुः॥

3.22.m:
3.110
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Now, when the day of consecration and the rest has arrived, one should awaken the glorious Blessed One with conches, drums, and wind instruments.
One should recite the awakening mantra.
Then the master of rites, bearing the image of countless aeons with arms raised, and the architect holding a water-jar, should enter the temple of the deity with the mantra: 'The Blessed One who is here, and whoever is the Blessed One here'.
Then one should bury all-herbs mixed with the five products of the cow, all-perfumes, all-jewels, and gold in the cavity of the pedestal.
And there, the mantras are:
'Mahābhāga' [Greatly Fortunate One];

भासः ॥
त्रिसुपर्णः ॥
भारुण्डम् ॥
मृत्युलांगलम् ॥
स्वस्ति न इंद्र द्वादशाध्यात्मम् ॥
आत्मव्यूहं च ततः सांवत्सरोद्दिष्टे काले भगवन्तं सुसमं सदृष्टिपीठिकायाम् ॥
ध्रुवा द्यौरिति निश्चलमनेनैव मन्त्रेण कुर्यात् ॥
नाम चास्योदीरयेत्॥
प्रतिष्ठासाम च पठेत् ।
सर्वश्च जनो लाजाकुसुमोत्करेण जयशब्देन कोलाहलं कुर्यात् ॥
वादित्राणि वादयेत् ॥
ओं नमो भगवते वासुदेवायेत्युदीरयेत् ॥
ब्रह्मसूक्तं च पठेत् ॥
अग्नेरायुरसीति जीवादानं कुर्यात् ॥
कल्पकश्च कलशपाणिः पठेत् ॥
ओं प्रतिष्ठितोसि भगवन्सुप्रतिष्ठा भवत्वियम् ॥
सान्निध्यं प्रतिपद्यस्व यजमानाभिवृद्धये ॥
शन्नोस्तु द्विपदे नित्यं शन्नश्चास्तु चतुष्पदे ॥
शन्नोस्तु सर्वलोकस्य शन्नो राज्ञस्तथैव च ॥
यजमानः सभृत्यो यो सपुत्रपशुबान्धवः ॥
रक्ष्यो भगवता नित्यं देशश्चायं नमोस्तु ते ॥
3.22.m:
'Bhāsa' [Radiance];
'Trisuparṇa';
'Bhāruṇḍa';
'Mṛtyulāṅgala';
'May Indra grant us well-being'; the twelve-verse hymn on the inner self;
and the 'Ātmavyūha'. Then, at the time appointed by the astrologer, [he should set] the Blessed One well-balanced upon the pedestal, facing right forward.
With this very mantra, 'Firm is the sky', he should make Him motionless.
And he should utter His name,
and recite the Sāman of consecration.
And all the people should make an uproar with shouts of victory and showers of fried grain and flowers.
He should have musical instruments played.
He should utter: 'Oṃ, homage to the Blessed One, Vāsudeva!'
And he should recite the Brahmasūkta.
With 'You are the life-span of Agni', he should perform the infusion of life.
And the master of rites, water-jar in hand, should recite:
'Oṃ! You are established, O Blessed One; may this consecration be auspicious! / Enter into proximity for the prosperity of the patron of the sacrifice!
May there be peace always for our two-footed, and may there be peace for our four-footed! / May there be peace for all the world, and likewise may there be peace for the king!
The patron of the sacrifice, together with his servants, sons, cattle, and kin, / is ever to be protected by the Blessed One, and so too this land. Homage to You!'

tataḥ svaśaktyā kalaśasahasrakalaśāṣṭaśata pañca vā śatāni catvāri vā śatamaṣṭādhikaṃ vā aṣṭāviṃśatirvāṣṭau vā svarcitānvanaspatikālāpagarbhaśaṅkhadhvanisvanena vādyaśabdena jayajayakāravaṃdiśabdena prasubhagānartitena deyāḥ ..
tataḥ pavitreṇopakalaśānviśrāmya vedyāṃ kṣipet ..
ghṛtavatīti ghṛtāvekṣaṃ darśayet ..
sahasraśīrṣeṇa śikhaṇḍodagrahaṇaśāṭakaṃ dadyāt ..
yuvāsuvāsa iti pratinirvasanaśāṭakam ..
idamāpaḥ pravahata ityācamanīyaṃ tato jānubhyāṃ pāṇibhyāṃ śirasā ca namaskāraṃ kuryāt ..
bṛhatsnapanametaddhi yaḥ karoti naro hareḥ..
sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇuloke mahīyate..
na kevalaṃ pratiṣṭhāyāṃ sarvadaivaṃ samācaret ..
śāntidaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ kāmyaṃ bṛhatsnapanamuttamama ..
divyāntarikṣabhaumānāmutpātānāṃ samudbhave ..
devadevasya rājendra bṛhatsnapanamācaret ..
nāsti loke samutpāto yo hyanena na śāmyati ..
ārogyakāmaḥ śrīkāmo mokṣakāmaśca bandhanāt ..
saubhāgyaśāntikāmaśca bṛhatsnapanamācaret ..
vidyārthī prāpnuyādvidyāṃ putrakāmastathātmajān ..
priyāśca mukhyāḥ prāpnoti yāśca kāmayate yadi ..
akāmakāmaḥ prāpnoti tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam ..
3.22.d:
3.111
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
अथ प्रतिष्ठितस्य भगवतो बृहत्स्नपनमारभेत् ततो गायत्रीं पठेत् ॥
इषेत्वेत्यनेन पतद्ग्रहं दद्यात् ॥
वैष्णवगायत्र्या पादुके ।
भूम्यावृत्वा यनोसीति मृदम् ॥
शन्न आप इत्यर्हणम् ।
देवेभ्यो वनस्पत इति दन्तकाष्ठम् ॥
यामालिखेति जिह्वानिर्लेखनम् ॥
आपोहिष्ठेत्याचमनम् ॥
पात्रेणार्घ्यम् ॥
युवासुवासा इति स्नानशाटकम् ॥
ध्रुवा द्यौरित्यासनम् ।
प्रतिष्ठासाम्ना पादपीठम् ॥
कनिक्रदेति बीजपात्रम् ॥
तेजोशुक्रमसीति दीपम् ॥
मुखादिन्द्रेत्यादर्शम् ॥
तथैव मुखालेपः ॥
रोध्रम् ॥ त्वक् कोलमज्जा ॥ वचा ॥ कुष्ठम् ॥ नीलोत्पलानि कुंकुमं चेति मुखालेपः ॥
सहस्रशीर्षेति तैलम् ॥
भद्रं कर्णेत्यनेनोद्वर्तनम् ॥
सुप्रतीकेन चमसा स्नानम्॥
ऋषभेन निष्पुंसनस्नानम् ॥
घृतवतीति घृतस्नानम्॥
दधिक्राव्ण इति दध्ना ॥
पयस्वतीति पयसा ॥
गंधद्वारेति गोमयेन ॥
गायत्र्या गोमूत्रेण॥
अघमर्षणेन पञ्चगव्येन ।
ध्रुवा द्यौरिति ध्रुवं निष्पुंसनेन ॥
मधुवाता ऋतायते इति मधुना ॥
सुप्रतीकेनेति इक्षुरसेन।
भौमेन गुडोदकेन॥
अथर्वशिरसा शर्करोदकेन॥
वामदेवेनेति नद्युभयकूलमृदा ॥
शांता द्यौरिति संगममृदा ॥
प्राणसूक्तेन सरोमृदा ॥
वाराहेणेति वराहोद्धृतमृदा॥
वामदेवेनेति गजदन्तमृदा ॥
वृषभेणेति वृषभशृंगोद्भवमृदा ॥
अश्वक्रान्तेति सर्वाभिः ॥
भारुन्देनेत्यामलकैः ॥
विकर्णेनेति रोध्रेण ।
ज्येष्ठसाम्नेति कालेयकेन ॥
बृहत्साम्नेति बीजपूरकेण ॥
कृष्णाजिनेनेति वर्णकस्नानीयेन ।
अग्न आयुरसीति तगरेण ।
श्रीसूक्तेनेति प्रियङ्गुना॥
विष्णोरराटमिति सिद्धार्थकैः ॥
कृष्णमणिनेति कृष्टेन ॥
शिरिभिटेनेति कुशोदकेन ।
या ओषधय इति सर्वौषधीभिः ॥
आब्रह्मन्ब्राह्मण इति बीजैः ॥
पुष्पवतीति पुष्पैः ॥
वनस्पते वीड्वंग इति वनस्पतिकलापैः ॥
पुष्पवतीति फलैः॥
आशुः शिशान इति रत्नैः ॥
गन्धद्वारेति गन्धैः ।
ओंकारनमस्कारपवित्रैः शिरःस्नानौषधीभिः यथा कुष्ठम्, रोध्रम्, मुस्ता, वचा, सर्षपाः, जयन्ती, विष्णुक्रान्ता, पुनर्नवा, ब्राह्मी, तगरम्, अतिबला, नवबला, नागबला, त्वक्पत्रम् ,अगुरुबालकम्, हरेणुकम्, लवङ्गम्, अगुरम्, उशीरम्, नालिका चूरकम्, द्वे हरिद्रे चेति ॥
एवं स्नानस्य कलशदानं भवति ॥
तत्रादावेवोङ्कारनमस्कारपवित्राभिर्ज्ञात्वा दशाध्यात्ममृत्पिण्डमाधुरैः सात्त्वतो दद्यात् ॥
ततः सामविन्महावामदेवलक्षरथन्तरशाक्वरभारुण्डबृहत्सामभिः ॥
अथर्वविदथर्वशिराः प्रत्यङ्गिरः शङ्खमणिप्राणसूक्तमणिप्रतिसरमणिभिः ॥
ऋग्वेदवित् गायत्रीसावित्रीगोसूक्ताश्च ॥
सूर्यसूक्तपुरुषसूक्तश्रीसूक्तैर्यजुर्वेदवित् ॥
कृष्णाजिनचमसषट्कषडृतुकूष्माण्डरुद्रद्रविणैः ।
ततः स्वशक्त्या कलशसहस्रकलशाष्टशत पञ्च वा शतानि चत्वारि वा शतमष्टाधिकं वा अष्टाविंशतिर्वाष्टौ वा स्वर्चितान्वनस्पतिकालापगर्भशङ्खध्वनिस्वनेन वाद्यशब्देन जयजयकारवंदिशब्देन प्रसुभगानर्तितेन देयाः ॥
ततः पवित्रेणोपकलशान्विश्राम्य वेद्यां क्षिपेत् ॥
घृतवतीति घृतावेक्षं दर्शयेत् ॥
सहस्रशीर्षेण शिखण्डोदग्रहणशाटकं दद्यात् ॥
युवासुवास इति प्रतिनिर्वसनशाटकम् ॥
इदमापः प्रवहत इत्याचमनीयं ततो जानुभ्यां पाणिभ्यां शिरसा च नमस्कारं कुर्यात् ॥
बृहत्स्नपनमेतद्धि यः करोति नरो हरेः॥
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो विष्णुलोके महीयते॥
न केवलं प्रतिष्ठायां सर्वदैवं समाचरेत् ॥
शान्तिदं पौष्टिकं काम्यं बृहत्स्नपनमुत्तमम ॥
दिव्यान्तरिक्षभौमानामुत्पातानां समुद्भवे ॥
देवदेवस्य राजेन्द्र बृहत्स्नपनमाचरेत् ॥
नास्ति लोके समुत्पातो यो ह्यनेन न शाम्यति ॥
आरोग्यकामः श्रीकामो मोक्षकामश्च बन्धनात् ॥
सौभाग्यशान्तिकामश्च बृहत्स्नपनमाचरेत् ॥
विद्यार्थी प्राप्नुयाद्विद्यां पुत्रकामस्तथात्मजान् ॥
प्रियाश्च मुख्याः प्राप्नोति याश्च कामयते यदि ॥
अकामकामः प्राप्नोति तद्विष्णोः परमं पदम् ॥
3.22.m:
3.111
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Now, one should begin the Great Bathing of the installed Lord; then one should recite the Gāyatrī.
With 'Iṣe tvā', one should present the spittoon.
With the Vaiṣṇava Gāyatrī, the pair of sandals.
With 'Bhūmyā vṛtvā yano 'si', clay.
With 'Śanno āpaḥ', the offering of honorific water.
With 'Devebhyo vanaspate', the tooth-stick.
With 'Yāmālikha', the tongue-scraper.
With 'Āpo hi ṣṭhā', sipping water.
With a vessel, the respectful offering of water.
With 'Yuvā suvāsāḥ', the bathing cloth.
With 'Dhruvā dyauḥ', the seat.
With the Pratiṣṭhā-sāman, the footstool.
With 'Kanikradat', the seed-vessel.
With 'Tejo śukram asi', the lamp.
With 'Mukhād indra', the mirror.
Likewise, the face-paste.
Lodhra, cinnamon, jujube marrow, sweet flag, costus, blue water-lilies, and saffron: this is the face-paste.
With 'Sahasraśīrṣā', the oil.
With 'Bhadraṃ karṇebhiḥ', the rubbing with unguents.
With Supratīka, bathing with the ladle.
With Ṛṣabha, bathing with the cleansing [water].
With 'Ghṛtavatī', the bath with clarified butter.
With 'Dadhikrāvṇaḥ', with curd.
With 'Payasvatī', with milk.
With 'Gandhadvārā', with cow dung.
With the Gāyatrī, with cow urine.
With Aghamarṣaṇa, with the five bovine products.
With 'Dhruvā dyauḥ', with the firm cleansing [water].
With 'Madhu vātā ṛtāyate', with honey.
With Supratīka, with sugarcane juice.
With the Bhauma [hymn], with molasses-water.
With the Atharvaśiras, with sugar-water.
With Vāmadeva, with clay from both banks of a river.
With 'Śāntā dyauḥ', with clay from a confluence.
With the Prāṇasūkta, with clay from a lake.
With the Vārāha [hymn], with clay uprooted by a boar.
With Vāmadeva, with clay from an elephant's tusk.
With Vṛṣabha, with clay from the horn of a bull.
With 'Aśvakrāntā', with all [clays combined].
With the Bhāruṇḍa [hymn], with myrobalan fruits.
With Vikarṇa, with lodhra.
With the Jyeṣṭhasāman, with kāleyaka sandal.
With the Bṛhatsāman, with citron.
With Kṛṣṇājina, with colored bathing powder.
With 'Agna āyur asi', with tagara.
With the Śrīsūkta, with priyaṅgu.
With 'Viṣṇo rarāṭam', with white mustard seeds.
With Kṛṣṇamaṇi, with cultivated [grain].
With Śiribhiṭa, with kuśa grass water.
With 'Yā oṣadhayaḥ', with all medicinal herbs.
With 'Ā brahman brāhmaṇaḥ', with seeds.
With 'Puṣpavatī', with flowers.
With 'Vanaspate vīḍvaṅgaḥ', with bundles of forest trees.
With 'Puṣpavatī', with fruits.
With 'Āśuḥ śiśānaḥ', with jewels.
With 'Gandhadvārā', with perfumes.
With medicinal herbs for the head-bath purified by the praṇava and obeisance, namely: costus, lodhra, mustā, sweet flag, mustard seeds, jayantī, viṣṇukrāntā, punarnavā, brāhmī, tagara, atibalā, navabalā, nāgabalā, cassia leaf, eaglewood, bālaka, hareṇuka, clove, agarwood, vetiver, nālikā, cūraka, and the two kinds of turmeric.
In this manner occurs the presentation of the pots for the bath.
There, right at the beginning, knowing [them] by means of the purifications with the praṇava and obeisance, the Sāttvata should present the ten spiritual sweet clay balls.
Then the knower of the Sāmaveda [should officiate] with the Mahāvāmadeva, Lakṣa, Rathantara, Śākvara, Bhāruṇḍa, and Bṛhat sāmans.
The knower of the Atharvaveda with the Atharvaśiras, Pratyaṅgiras, Śaṅkhamaṇi, Prāṇasūkta, and Maṇipratisara jewels.
The knower of the Ṛgveda with the Gāyatrī, Sāvitrī, and Gosūkta.
The knower of the Yajurveda with the Sūryasūkta, Puruṣasūkta, and Śrīsūkta;
with the Kṛṣṇājina, Camasa, Ṣaṭka, Ṣaḍṛtu, Kūṣmāṇḍa, and Rudradraviṇa [hymns].
Then, according to one's capacity, a thousand pots, eight hundred pots, five hundred, four [hundred], a hundred and eight, twenty-eight, or eight, well-worshipped, containing bundles of forest trees, should be offered amidst the sounding of conches, musical instruments, cries of 'Victory! Victory!', words of bards, and auspicious dancing.
Then, having rested the subsidiary pots with a strainer, he should place them on the altar.
With 'Ghṛtavatī', he should present the gazing into clarified butter.
With 'Sahasraśīrṣā', he should present the cloth for wiping the head-hair.
With 'Yuvā suvāsāḥ', the cloth for changing garments.
With 'Idam āpaḥ pravahata', the water for sipping; then he should make prostration with his knees, hands, and head.
Indeed, the man who performs this Great Bathing for Hari,
freed from all sins, is glorified in the world of Viṣṇu.
One should perform it not only at an installation, but at all times;
the Great Bathing is supreme, bestowing peace, nourishing, and fulfilling desires.
Upon the occurrence of portents—celestial, atmospheric, or terrestrial—
O king of kings, one should perform the Great Bathing of the God of gods.
There is no portent in the world that is not pacified by this.
One who desires health, one who desires fortune, one who desires liberation from bondage,
and one who desires good luck and peace should perform the Great Bathing.
A seeker of knowledge will attain knowledge; likewise, one desiring a son [will attain] offspring;
and he attains beloved and foremost [women], if he so desires.
One who has no desire desires and attains that supreme abode of Viṣṇu.
