3.26.m:
Because they delight in traveling by horse, they are called the Aśvins. / On the second day of the bright fortnight of Caitra, fasting, with senses subdued,
intent and pure, one should worship the two Nāsatyas, the physicians of the gods, / with an abundance of perfumes, garlands, salutations, incense, lamps, and food.
Having fashioned their likenesses, a man should worship the two Nāsatyas; / then he should especially offer a garland of lamps to the two at night.
He should give both gold and silver to brahmins as a sacrificial fee. / Closing his two eyes, a man should remember Viṣṇu;
he becomes radiant with splendor and is endowed with sight. / He should sustain his life with curd mixed with ghee.
Having performed the eye-observance for twelve years, he becomes an acknowledged lord of the earth, / endowed with a handsome form, crushing the hosts of his enemies, delighting in dharma, foremost among the best of kings.

गार्हस्थं मा प्रणाशं मे यातु धर्मार्थ कामदम् ॥ 5 ॥
अग्नयो मा प्रणश्यन्तु मा प्रणश्यन्तु देवताः ॥
पितरो मा प्रणश्यन्तु मत्तो दांपत्यभेदतः ॥ 6 ॥
3.27.m:
This observance is declared to be purifying, destroying enemies, / bestowing good fortune, and dispelling disease, O king, O foremost of the Yādava race; it should be performed diligently by a woman as well.
3.132 / Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Listen to me, O king, regarding the second day of the unempty bed, / fasting on which a woman never undergoes widowhood,
nor does a man ever suffer separation from his wife. / That lunar day is to be observed on the second day of the dark fortnight under the constellation Śravaṇa.
Upon a well-spread bed, O Bhārgava, one should worship / Viṣṇu and the goddess Lakṣmī with fruits, flowers, perfumes, and respectful offerings.
Then one should offer food-offerings, a lamp, and incense according to one's capacity. / Then, having worshipped the lord of gods, pure, one should recite this mantra:
"O bearer of the Śrīvatsa, O beloved of Śrī, O abode of Śrī, O lord of Śrī, O Acyuta, / let not my householdership, which yields dharma, wealth, and desire, come to ruin!
Let not the fires perish, let not the deities perish, / let not the ancestors perish away from me through a breach in marital union!

3.27.s:
lakṣmyā viyujyate deva na kadācidyathā bhavān ..
tathā kalatrasaṃbandho deva mā me vinaśyatu .. 7 ..
3.27.d:
लक्ष्म्या वियुज्यते देव न कदाचिद्यथा भवान् ॥
तथा कलत्रसंबन्धो देव मा मे विनश्यतु ॥ 7 ॥
3.27.m: Just as you, O God, are never parted from Lakṣmī, / so, O God, let not my marital bond be destroyed!

3.27.s:
lakṣmyā na śūnyaṃ varada yathā te śayanaṃ sadā ..
śayyā mamāpyaśūnyāstu tathaiva madhusūdana .. 8 ..
3.27.d:
लक्ष्म्या न शून्यं वरद यथा ते शयनं सदा ॥
शय्या ममाप्यशून्यास्तु तथैव मधुसूदन ॥ 8 ॥
3.27.m: Just as your bed is never empty of Lakṣmī, O boon-giver, / so let my bed also be never empty, O Madhusūdana!"

3.27.s:
evaṃ prasādya deveśaṃ naktaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ ..
brāhmaṇāya dvitīyehni pradadyāccaiva dakṣiṇām..9..
3.27.d:
एवं प्रसाद्य देवेशं नक्तं भुञ्जीत वाग्यतः ॥
ब्राह्मणाय द्वितीयेह्नि प्रदद्याच्चैव दक्षिणाम्॥9॥
3.27.m: Having thus propitiated the lord of gods, he should eat at night, restrained in speech. / And on the second day he should bestow a sacrificial fee on a brahmin.

3.27.s:
śayane ca dvijendrāya gate māsa catuṣṭaye..
tasya janmatrayaṃ rājangṛhabhaṅgo na jāyate..3.132.10..
3.27.d:
शयने च द्विजेन्द्राय गते मास चतुष्टये॥
तस्य जन्मत्रयं राजन्गृहभङ्गो न जायते॥3.132.10॥
3.27.m: And when four months have passed, [he gives] a bed to a foremost twice-born. / For three lifetimes, O king, no destruction of his household occurs.

3.27.s:
aśūnyaśayanaścāsau dharmakarmārthasādhakaḥ ..
bhavatyavyāhataiśvaryaḥ puruṣo nātra saṃśayaḥ..11..
3.27.d:
अशून्यशयनश्चासौ धर्मकर्मार्थसाधकः ॥
भवत्यव्याहतैश्वर्यः पुरुषो नात्र संशयः॥11॥
3.27.m: And he has an unempty bed, accomplishes dharma, duty, and wealth, / and becomes a man of unimpeded sovereignty—there is no doubt about this.

3.27.s:
vaidhavyahīnā subhagā virogā pativratā dharmaparā ca sādhvī ..
rūpeṇa yuktā na bhayānvitā ca nārī bhavetsarvaguṇopapannā ..12..
3.133
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
śuklapakṣa tṛtīyāyāṃ sopavāso jitendriyaḥ ..
maṇḍalatritayaṃ kuryādvarṇakena pṛthakpṛthak .. 1 ..
maṇḍalaṃ dakṣiṇe bhāge śvetaṃ kuryānnaro bhaveta ..
raktaṃ madhye'pyadhaḥ kuryādudakchvetaṃ dhruvasya tu.. 2 ..
viṣṇoḥ padatrayaṃ teṣu pūjyaṃ syānmaṇḍaleṣu ca ..
bhūmau ca prathamaṃ pādaṃ dvitīyaṃ sūryamaṇḍale .. 3 ..
tṛtīyaṃ tu dhruve deve pūjayetprayataḥ śuciḥ ..
yathā maṇḍalavarṇāṅko gandhamālyādibhirdvija .. 4 ..
tadviṣṇoḥ paramityeva homamantro vidhīyate ..
trivikramāyeti tathā strīśūdrasya dvijottama .. 5 ..
akṣatāni tilānyājyaṃ homayetsaṃyutaṃ trayam ..
tāmraraupyasuvarṇāni śaktyā dadyāttu dakṣiṇām .. 6 ..
3.27.d:
वैधव्यहीना सुभगा विरोगा पतिव्रता धर्मपरा च साध्वी ॥
रूपेण युक्ता न भयान्विता च नारी भवेत्सर्वगुणोपपन्ना ॥12॥
3.133
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
शुक्लपक्ष तृतीयायां सोपवासो जितेन्द्रियः ॥
मण्डलत्रितयं कुर्याद्वर्णकेन पृथक्पृथक् ॥ 1 ॥
मण्डलं दक्षिणे भागे श्वेतं कुर्यान्नरो भवेत ॥
रक्तं मध्येऽप्यधः कुर्यादुदक्छ्वेतं ध्रुवस्य तु॥ 2 ॥
विष्णोः पदत्रयं तेषु पूज्यं स्यान्मण्डलेषु च ॥
भूमौ च प्रथमं पादं द्वितीयं सूर्यमण्डले ॥ 3 ॥
तृतीयं तु ध्रुवे देवे पूजयेत्प्रयतः शुचिः ॥
यथा मण्डलवर्णाङ्को गन्धमाल्यादिभिर्द्विज ॥ 4 ॥
तद्विष्णोः परमित्येव होममन्त्रो विधीयते ॥
त्रिविक्रमायेति तथा स्त्रीशूद्रस्य द्विजोत्तम ॥ 5 ॥
अक्षतानि तिलान्याज्यं होमयेत्संयुतं त्रयम् ॥
ताम्ररौप्यसुवर्णानि शक्त्या दद्यात्तु दक्षिणाम् ॥ 6 ॥
3.27.m:
Free from widowhood, fortunate, free from disease, devoted to her husband, intent on dharma, virtuous, / endowed with beauty, free from fear, a woman becomes possessed of all good qualities.
3.133 / Mārkaṇḍeya said: / On the third day of the bright fortnight, fasting, with senses subdued, / one should make three sacred diagrams separately with pigment.
A man should make a white sacred diagram in the southern part; / in the middle below, a red one; and in the north, a white one for Dhruva.
The three steps of Viṣṇu are to be worshipped in these sacred diagrams: / the first step on the ground, the second in the orb of the sun,
and the third in the divine Dhruva, he should worship, intent and pure, / with perfumes, garlands, and the like, according to the color-mark of the sacred diagram, O twice-born.
"Tad viṣṇoḥ paramam..." is prescribed as the mantra for the fire oblation; / and "To Trivikrama" [is the mantra] for a woman or a śūdra, O best of the twice-born.
He should offer into the fire the three combined: unbroken grains, sesame seeds, and ghee. / And according to his ability, he should give copper, silver, and gold as a sacrificial fee.

3.27.s:
bhojanaṃ ca trimadhuraṃ bhojayedbrāhmaṇottamam ..
prāṇayātrāṃ ca kurvīta trigavyena ca taddinam .. 7 ..
evaṃ varṣatrayaṃ kṛtvā vratānte vai trihāyanam ..
brāhmaṇāya tu gāṃ dattvā sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt .. 8 ..
bhūmau tathāntarikṣe ca divi caiva narottama ..
gatistasyā pratihatā bhavatyariniṣūdana .. 9 ..
trīṇi varṣasahasrāṇi sarvagasyāvicāriṇaḥ ..
mānasaṃ vācikaṃ caiva kāyikaṃ ca vimuñcati .. 3.133.10 ..
sarvapāpaṃ mahābhāga manuṣyo jāyate tayā ..
kule dhanāḍhyo bhavati rūpadraviṇasaṃyute .. 11 .
virogaḥ sarvasiddhārthastrivargasya ca sādhakaḥ ..
kṛtvā dvādaśavarṣāṇi viṣṇuloke mahīyate .. 12 ..
3.27.d:
भोजनं च त्रिमधुरं भोजयेद्ब्राह्मणोत्तमम् ॥
प्राणयात्रां च कुर्वीत त्रिगव्येन च तद्दिनम् ॥ 7 ॥
एवं वर्षत्रयं कृत्वा व्रतान्ते वै त्रिहायनम् ॥
ब्राह्मणाय तु गां दत्त्वा सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात् ॥ 8 ॥
भूमौ तथान्तरिक्षे च दिवि चैव नरोत्तम ॥
गतिस्तस्या प्रतिहता भवत्यरिनिषूदन ॥ 9 ॥
त्रीणि वर्षसहस्राणि सर्वगस्याविचारिणः ॥
मानसं वाचिकं चैव कायिकं च विमुञ्चति ॥ 3.133.10 ॥
सर्वपापं महाभाग मनुष्यो जायते तया ॥
कुले धनाढ्यो भवति रूपद्रविणसंयुते ॥ 11 ।
विरोगः सर्वसिद्धार्थस्त्रिवर्गस्य च साधकः ॥
कृत्वा द्वादशवर्षाणि विष्णुलोके महीयते ॥ 12 ॥
3.27.m:
And he should feed an excellent brahmin a meal of three sweet substances,
and he should sustain his life that day with three cow-products.
Having done this for three years, at the end of the vow, having indeed given
a three-year-old cow to a brahmin, he obtains all desires.
On earth, likewise in the intermediate space, and in heaven, O best of men,
O slayer of foes, his movement becomes unimpeded
for three thousand years, going everywhere without hindrance.
He is released from mental, vocal, and bodily
all evil, O fortunate one; through that he is born a man
in a family rich in wealth, endowed with beauty and prosperity.
Free from disease, his every purpose accomplished, achieving the three aims of life,
having observed [this vow] for twelve years, he is glorified in the world of Viṣṇu.

3.27.s:
tatrāpi nityaṃ varadaṃ vareṇyaṃ lakṣmīsahāyaṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇam ..
paśyatyamoghaṃ vibhumapratarkyaṃ sanātanaṃ duḥkhavināśahetuma.. .. 13 ..
.. mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
dvitīyaṃ tava vakṣyāmi śṛṇu traivikramaṃ vratam ..
bhūmistu prathamaḥ pādo hyantarikṣaṃ tathā param .. 1 ..
tṛtīyaśca divaṃ jñeyo devadevasya cakriṇaḥ ..
bhuvaḥ patiḥ smṛto vahnirantarikṣaṃ tathā param .. 2 ..
divaḥ patistathā sūryastacca viṣṇoḥ padatrayam ..
jyeṣṭhaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ sopavāso jitendriyaḥ .. 3 ..
kalye kūpajalasnāto vahniṃ sampūjayennaraḥ ..
gandhamālyanamaskāradhūpadīpānnasaṃpadā .. 4 ..
nadījale tata. snātvā madhyaṃ prāpte divākare ..
vāyoḥ saṃpūjanaṃ kṛtvā saktūndadyāddvijātaye .. 5 ..
snātvā ca sarasītoye sāyaṃ sūryaṃ samarcayet ..
tataśca naktaṃ cāśnīyāddhaviṣyaṃ vāgyataḥ śuciḥ .. 6 ..
3.27.d:
तत्रापि नित्यं वरदं वरेण्यं लक्ष्मीसहायं पुरुषं पुराणम् ॥
पश्यत्यमोघं विभुमप्रतर्क्यं सनातनं दुःखविनाशहेतुम॥ ॥ 13 ॥
॥ मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
द्वितीयं तव वक्ष्यामि शृणु त्रैविक्रमं व्रतम् ॥
भूमिस्तु प्रथमः पादो ह्यन्तरिक्षं तथा परम् ॥ 1 ॥
तृतीयश्च दिवं ज्ञेयो देवदेवस्य चक्रिणः ॥
भुवः पतिः स्मृतो वह्निरन्तरिक्षं तथा परम् ॥ 2 ॥
दिवः पतिस्तथा सूर्यस्तच्च विष्णोः पदत्रयम् ॥
ज्येष्ठशुक्लतृतीयायां सोपवासो जितेन्द्रियः ॥ 3 ॥
कल्ये कूपजलस्नातो वह्निं सम्पूजयेन्नरः ॥
गन्धमाल्यनमस्कारधूपदीपान्नसंपदा ॥ 4 ॥
नदीजले तत। स्नात्वा मध्यं प्राप्ते दिवाकरे ॥
वायोः संपूजनं कृत्वा सक्तून्दद्याद्द्विजातये ॥ 5 ॥
स्नात्वा च सरसीतोये सायं सूर्यं समर्चयेत् ॥
ततश्च नक्तं चाश्नीयाद्धविष्यं वाग्यतः शुचिः ॥ 6 ॥
3.27.m:
There too, he constantly beholds the boon-giver, the foremost, accompanied by Lakṣmī, the ancient Cosmic Person,
the unfailing, the all-pervading, the unfathomable, the eternal cause of the destruction of sorrow.
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
I will tell you the second vow of Trivikrama; listen.
The earth is the first step, and the intermediate space is the second;
and heaven is to be known as the third of the God of gods, the Discus-bearer.
Agni is declared the lord of the earth, and likewise next the intermediate space;
and Sūrya is the lord of heaven: that is the triad of steps of Viṣṇu.
Fasting on the third day of the bright fortnight of Jyeṣṭha, with senses conquered,
having bathed in the morning in well-water, a man should worship Agni
with an abundance of perfumes, garlands, obeisances, incense, lamps, and food.
Then, having bathed in river water when the sun has reached midday,
having performed the worship of Vāyu, he should give barley-groats to a twice-born.
And having bathed in lake water in the evening, he should worship Sūrya;
and then, restrained in speech and pure, he should eat sacrificial food at night.

3.27.s:
evaṃ saṃvatsare rājankṛtvā vratamatandritaḥ ..
samāpayitvā vaiśākhe dadyādvipreṣu dakṣiṇām .. 7 ..
tāmraṃ rūpyaṃ suvarṇaṃ ca trīṇi lohāni yādava ..
vāsoyugaṃ ca soṣṇīṣaṃ trīṇi vāsāṃsi cāpyatha .. 8 ..
upānaho yugaṃ chatraṃ trīṇi cemāni bhaktitaḥ ..
etatsaṃvatsaraṃ kṛtvā narastraivikramaṃ vratam .. 9 ..
sarvakāmasamṛddhasya yajñasya phalamaśnute ..
vimānenārkavarṇena kiṅkiṇījālamālinā .. 3.134.10 ..
devarājagaṇāḍhyena vīṇāmurajanādinā ..
annamāyuḥ sutāścaiva prasanne garuḍadhvaje ..11..
ākrāntalokatritayasya tasya padatrayaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ variṣṭha ..
saṃpūjya kāmānmanujā labhante gatiṃ yatheṣṭāṃ puruṣapravīra .. 12 ..
3.135
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
vyākhyātaṃ te mahābhāga tava traivikamaṃ vratama ..
tṛtīyaṃ nṛpaśārdūla tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu .. 1 ..
3.27.d:
एवं संवत्सरे राजन्कृत्वा व्रतमतन्द्रितः ॥
समापयित्वा वैशाखे दद्याद्विप्रेषु दक्षिणाम् ॥ 7 ॥
ताम्रं रूप्यं सुवर्णं च त्रीणि लोहानि यादव ॥
वासोयुगं च सोष्णीषं त्रीणि वासांसि चाप्यथ ॥ 8 ॥
उपानहो युगं छत्रं त्रीणि चेमानि भक्तितः ॥
एतत्संवत्सरं कृत्वा नरस्त्रैविक्रमं व्रतम् ॥ 9 ॥
सर्वकामसमृद्धस्य यज्ञस्य फलमश्नुते ॥
विमानेनार्कवर्णेन किङ्किणीजालमालिना ॥ 3.134.10 ॥
देवराजगणाढ्येन वीणामुरजनादिना ॥
अन्नमायुः सुताश्चैव प्रसन्ने गरुडध्वजे ॥11॥
आक्रान्तलोकत्रितयस्य तस्य पदत्रयं धर्मभृतां वरिष्ठ ॥
संपूज्य कामान्मनुजा लभन्ते गतिं यथेष्टां पुरुषप्रवीर ॥ 12 ॥
3.135
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
व्याख्यातं ते महाभाग तव त्रैविकमं व्रतम ॥
तृतीयं नृपशार्दूल तन्मे निगदतः शृणु ॥ 1 ॥
3.27.m:
Performing the vow thus for a year, unwearied, O king,
having concluded it in Vaiśākha, he should give a sacrificial fee to brahmins:
copper, silver, and gold—the three metals, O Yādava;
and a pair of garments along with a turban—and three garments,
a pair of sandals, and an umbrella—these three, with devotion.
Having performed this vow of Trivikrama for a year, a man
attains the fruit of a sacrifice abundant in all desires.
In a celestial aerial chariot having the color of the sun, adorned with a network of tiny bells,
filled with hosts of king-like gods, resounding with vīṇās and muraja drums,
food, longevity, and sons [are granted] when Garuḍadhvaja is pleased.
Having worshipped the three steps of him who stepped over the three worlds, O best among upholders of dharma,
men attain their desires and movement wherever they wish, O hero among men.
3.135
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
The vow of Trivikrama has been explained to you, O fortunate one.
Hear from me as I speak of the third, O tiger among kings.

3.27.s:
jyeṣṭha śuklatṛtīyāyāṃ naraḥ samyagupoṣitaḥ ..
bhuvassaṃpūjanaṃ kuryāddhūpamālyānulepanaiḥ .. 2 ..
dīpairannaiśca vividhairdadyādvipreṣu dakṣiṇām ..
bījapūrṇāni pātrāṇi sahiraṇyāni śaktitaḥ .. 3 ..
pūjaivamantarikṣasya hyāṣāḍheti vidhīyate ..
dakṣiṇā tatra dātavyā vāsoyugmaṃ dvijātaye .. 4 ..
divaḥ pūjā ca kartavyā śrāvaṇe prāgvadeva tu ..
chatraṃ copānaho yugmaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ tatra dāpayet .. 5 ..
evaṃ māsatrayeṇeha pāraṇaṃ prathamaṃ bhavet ..
māsatrayeṇa cānyattu māsatrayyaṃ punastataḥ .. 6 ..
tato māsatrayeṇānyamenamabdena cānagha ..
vijñeyaṃ dharmanityasya pāraṇānāṃ catuṣṭayam .. 7 ..
prathamaṃ pāraṇaṃ kṛtvā agniṣṭomaphalaṃ labheta ..
atirātraphalaṃ rājandvitīye pāraṇe tathā .. 8 ..
tṛtīye pāraṇe vidvānvājapeyaphalaṃ labheta ..
caturthe pāraṇe proktaṃ rājasūyasya yatphalam .. 9 ..
3.27.d:
ज्येष्ठ शुक्लतृतीयायां नरः सम्यगुपोषितः ॥
भुवस्संपूजनं कुर्याद्धूपमाल्यानुलेपनैः ॥ 2 ॥
दीपैरन्नैश्च विविधैर्दद्याद्विप्रेषु दक्षिणाम् ॥
बीजपूर्णानि पात्राणि सहिरण्यानि शक्तितः ॥ 3 ॥
पूजैवमन्तरिक्षस्य ह्याषाढेति विधीयते ॥
दक्षिणा तत्र दातव्या वासोयुग्मं द्विजातये ॥ 4 ॥
दिवः पूजा च कर्तव्या श्रावणे प्राग्वदेव तु ॥
छत्रं चोपानहो युग्मं दक्षिणां तत्र दापयेत् ॥ 5 ॥
एवं मासत्रयेणेह पारणं प्रथमं भवेत् ॥
मासत्रयेण चान्यत्तु मासत्रय्यं पुनस्ततः ॥ 6 ॥
ततो मासत्रयेणान्यमेनमब्देन चानघ ॥
विज्ञेयं धर्मनित्यस्य पारणानां चतुष्टयम् ॥ 7 ॥
प्रथमं पारणं कृत्वा अग्निष्टोमफलं लभेत ॥
अतिरात्रफलं राजन्द्वितीये पारणे तथा ॥ 8 ॥
तृतीये पारणे विद्वान्वाजपेयफलं लभेत ॥
चतुर्थे पारणे प्रोक्तं राजसूयस्य यत्फलम् ॥ 9 ॥

3.27.s:
vimānenārkavarṇena kiṅkiṇījālamālinā ..
haṃsayuktena divyena vīṇāmurajanādinā .. 3.135.10 ..
varāpsarogaṇāḍhyena kāmukenāpi cāruṇā ..
yatheṣṭagāmī bhavati bahukālamasaṃśayam .. 11 ..
mānuṣye janma cāsādya triśuklatvamavāpnuyāt ..
vidyā janma tathā karma nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 12 ..
trivikramasyāpratimasya tasya carācareśasya padatrayaṃ ca ..
yaḥ pūjayettasya bhavanti kāmāḥ sarve samṛddhā na hi saṃśayo'tra .. 13 ..
3.27.d:
विमानेनार्कवर्णेन किङ्किणीजालमालिना ॥
हंसयुक्तेन दिव्येन वीणामुरजनादिना ॥ 3.135.10 ॥
वराप्सरोगणाढ्येन कामुकेनापि चारुणा ॥
यथेष्टगामी भवति बहुकालमसंशयम् ॥ 11 ॥
मानुष्ये जन्म चासाद्य त्रिशुक्लत्वमवाप्नुयात् ॥
विद्या जन्म तथा कर्म नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥ 12 ॥
त्रिविक्रमस्याप्रतिमस्य तस्य चराचरेशस्य पदत्रयं च ॥
यः पूजयेत्तस्य भवन्ति कामाः सर्वे समृद्धा न हि संशयोऽत्र ॥ 13 ॥
3.27.m:
In a celestial aerial chariot having the color of the sun, adorned with a network of tiny bells,
yoked with swans, divine, resounding with vīṇās and muraja drums,
filled with groups of choice apsarases, moving as he pleases, beautiful,
he travels wherever he desires for a long time, without doubt.
And having obtained birth in human state, he attains threefold purity
of learning, birth, and action; no doubt is to be entertained here.
And whoever worships the three steps of that peerless Trivikrama,
the lord of the moving and unmoving, all his desires become fulfilled; there is no doubt of this.

3.28.s:
3.136
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
ārādhanaṃ hi devasya tasya vakṣyāmi yādava ..
viṣṇoramitavīryasya tannibodha narādhipa .. 1 ..
3.28.d:
3.136
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
आराधनं हि देवस्य तस्य वक्ष्यामि यादव ॥
विष्णोरमितवीर्यस्य तन्निबोध नराधिप ॥ 1 ॥
3.28.m:
3.136
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
I shall speak of the worship of that god, O Yādava,
of Viṣṇu of immeasurable prowess; understand that, O ruler of men.

3.28.s:
vāyvarkacandradehastu trimūrtirbhagavānhariḥ ..
agniṣṭomo jagatyasmim̐ścandrārkau parikīrtitau .. 2 ..
3.28.d:
वाय्वर्कचन्द्रदेहस्तु त्रिमूर्तिर्भगवान्हरिः ॥
अग्निष्टोमो जगत्यस्मिम्̐श्चन्द्रार्कौ परिकीर्तितौ ॥ 2 ॥
3.28.m:
The Blessed Lord Hari has three forms, having the bodies of Vāyu, Sūrya, and Candra;
in this world, the Agniṣṭoma is proclaimed as the moon and the sun.

3.28.s:
sarvādhāraśca bhagavānvāyuḥ sarvagatastathā ..
pañca bhūtātmakaṃ sarvaṃ jagadetaccarācaram .. 3 ..
3.28.d:
सर्वाधारश्च भगवान्वायुः सर्वगतस्तथा ॥
पञ्च भूतात्मकं सर्वं जगदेतच्चराचरम् ॥ 3 ॥
3.28.m:
And the Blessed Lord Vāyu is the support of all and omnipresent;
all this universe, moving and unmoving, consists of the five elements.

3.28.s:
ādhārabhūtau dvāvetau pṛthivī gaganaṃ tathā ..
ādheyo viddhi dharmajña tathā bhūtatrayaṃ sadā .. 4 ..
3.28.d:
आधारभूतौ द्वावेतौ पृथिवी गगनं तथा ॥
आधेयो विद्धि धर्मज्ञ तथा भूतत्रयं सदा ॥ 4 ॥
3.28.m:
These two, the earth and the sky, are the substrata;
know always, O knower of dharma, the triad of elements to be that which is supported:

3.28.s:
candrādityau ca vāyuśca sarvasya jagato dvija ..
ādhārādheyabhāvena bhūtairvṛtamidaṃ jagata .. 5 ..
3.28.d:
चन्द्रादित्यौ च वायुश्च सर्वस्य जगतो द्विज ॥
आधाराधेयभावेन भूतैर्वृतमिदं जगत ॥ 5 ॥
3.28.m:
the moon and sun, and Vāyu, O twice-born, for the entire world.
Through the state of substratum and supported, this world is pervaded by the elements;

3.28.s:
naiva cāsti jagatyasminkiñcidbhūtavivarjitam ..
tasmādvā yādavaśreṣṭha bhūtairvṛtamidaṃ jagat ..
brahmāṇaṃ viddhi bhūmiṃ ca gaganaṃ tadanantaram ..
aṇḍasyāntaḥ sthitā devā vāyvarkaṃ tuhināṃśavaḥ .. 6 ..
3.28.d:
नैव चास्ति जगत्यस्मिन्किञ्चिद्भूतविवर्जितम् ॥
तस्माद्वा यादवश्रेष्ठ भूतैर्वृतमिदं जगत् ॥
ब्रह्माणं विद्धि भूमिं च गगनं तदनन्तरम् ॥
अण्डस्यान्तः स्थिता देवा वाय्वर्कं तुहिनांशवः ॥ 6 ॥
3.28.m:
and there is nothing whatever in this world devoid of the elements.
Therefore, O best of Yādavas, this world is pervaded by the elements.
Know the earth to be Brahmā, and immediately following, the sky;
the gods situated within the Cosmic Egg are wind, sun, and moon.

3.28.s:
pālayanti jagatsarvaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam ..
tathaivāṇḍasthitāḥ sarve pālayanti jagattrayam .. 7 ..
3.28.d:
पालयन्ति जगत्सर्वं सदेवासुरमानुषम् ॥
तथैवाण्डस्थिताः सर्वे पालयन्ति जगत्त्रयम् ॥ 7 ॥
3.28.m: They protect the whole world together with the gods, asuras, and humans. / In the same way, all those situated in the cosmic egg protect the three worlds.

3.28.s:
tathaiva dehināṃ dehe pālayanti śarīragāḥ ..
vātapitta kaphatvena vāyvarkaśiśirāṃśavaḥ .. 8 ..
3.28.d:
तथैव देहिनां देहे पालयन्ति शरीरगाः ॥
वातपित्त कफत्वेन वाय्वर्कशिशिरांशवः ॥ 8 ॥
3.28.m: Just so, situated in the body, they protect the bodies of embodied beings: / wind, sun, and moon as wind, bile, and phlegm.

3.28.s:
ādhāraṃ jagato yadvad brahmāṇḍaṃ parikīrtitam ..
tathā dehe śarīrasthā dehināṃ hi tvagucyate .. 9 ..
3.28.d:
आधारं जगतो यद्वद् ब्रह्माण्डं परिकीर्तितम् ॥
तथा देहे शरीरस्था देहिनां हि त्वगुच्यते ॥ 9 ॥
3.28.m: Just as the cosmic egg is declared to be the container of the world, / so the skin present on the body of embodied beings is called their container.

3.28.s:
brahmāṇḍe dehidehe'pi gaganaṃ dṛśyate dvayoḥ ..
brahmāṇḍavaccharīrāṇi vāyvarkaśiśirāṃśavaḥ .. 3.136.10 ..
3.28.d:
ब्रह्माण्डे देहिदेहेऽपि गगनं दृश्यते द्वयोः ॥
ब्रह्माण्डवच्छरीराणि वाय्वर्कशिशिरांशवः ॥ 3.136.10 ॥
3.28.m: In the cosmic egg and also in the body of an embodied being, space is seen in both. / Like the cosmic egg, the bodies are maintained by wind, sun, and moon,

3.28.s:
pālayanti mahīpāla vātapittakaphāṃśakāḥ ..
vāyvarkacandra dehastu tasmādviṣṇustrimūrtidhṛt .. 11 ..
3.28.d:
पालयन्ति महीपाल वातपित्तकफांशकाः ॥
वाय्वर्कचन्द्र देहस्तु तस्माद्विष्णुस्त्रिमूर्तिधृत् ॥ 11 ॥
3.28.m: which have the portions of wind, bile, and phlegm, O king. / The body consists of wind, sun, and moon; therefore Viṣṇu bears three forms.

3.28.s:
tasya saṃpūjanaṃ kāryaṃ yathāvacchṛṇu bhārgava ..
jyeṣṭhaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ nirāhāro naraḥ śuciḥ .. 12 ..
3.28.d:
तस्य संपूजनं कार्यं यथावच्छृणु भार्गव ॥
ज्येष्ठशुक्लतृतीयायां निराहारो नरः शुचिः ॥ 12 ॥
3.28.m: Hear properly how his worship is to be performed, O Bhārgava: / on the third day of the bright fortnight of Jyeṣṭha, a pure man, without food,

3.28.s:
trimūrtipūjanaṃ kuryāddvitīyāyāṃ yathāvidhi ..
kūpanādeyatāḍākamiśraiḥ snātaḥ śucirjalaiḥ .. 13 ..
3.28.d:
त्रिमूर्तिपूजनं कुर्याद्द्वितीयायां यथाविधि ॥
कूपनादेयताडाकमिश्रैः स्नातः शुचिर्जलैः ॥ 13 ॥
3.28.m: should perform the worship of the threefold form according to rule, having fasted on the second, / purified and bathed with waters mixed from wells, rivers, and ponds.

3.28.s:
pratyūṣe pūjayedvāyumanulipte śubhe sthale ..
gandha mālyanamaskāradhūpadīpānnasaṃpadā .. 14 ..
3.28.d:
प्रत्यूषे पूजयेद्वायुमनुलिप्ते शुभे स्थले ॥
गन्ध माल्यनमस्कारधूपदीपान्नसंपदा ॥ 14 ॥
3.28.m: At dawn, he should worship Wind in an auspicious, smeared place / with an abundance of perfumes, garlands, obeisance, incense, lamps, and food.

3.28.s:
homaṃ kuryādyavairmukhyairvastraṃ dadyāddvijātaye ..
madhyāhne pūjayedvahnau tathā sūryamatandritaḥ .. 15 ..
3.28.d:
होमं कुर्याद्यवैर्मुख्यैर्वस्त्रं दद्याद्द्विजातये ॥
मध्याह्ने पूजयेद्वह्नौ तथा सूर्यमतन्द्रितः ॥ 15 ॥
3.28.m: He should make an oblation with choice barley and give clothing to a twice-born. / At midday, he should worship the Sun in the fire without slackening.

3.28.s:
tilāṃśca juhuyādvahnau dadyāddvipreṣu dakṣiṇām ..
sūryāstamanavelāyāṃ jale candraṃ ca pūjayet .. 15 ..
3.28.d:
तिलांश्च जुहुयाद्वह्नौ दद्याद्द्विप्रेषु दक्षिणाम् ॥
सूर्यास्तमनवेलायां जले चन्द्रं च पूजयेत् ॥ 15 ॥
3.28.m: He should offer sesame seeds into the fire and give a sacrificial fee to brahmins. / At the time of sunset, he should worship the Moon in water.

3.28.s:
ghṛtena homaṃ kurvīta rajataṃ dakṣiṇā smṛtā ..
naktaṃ bhuñjīta dharmajña tailahīnaṃ tato naraḥ .. 17 ..
3.28.d:
घृतेन होमं कुर्वीत रजतं दक्षिणा स्मृता ॥
नक्तं भुञ्जीत धर्मज्ञ तैलहीनं ततो नरः ॥ 17 ॥
3.28.m: He should perform the oblation with clarified butter; silver is prescribed as the sacrificial fee. / At night, O knower of dharma, the man should then eat food free from oil.

3.28.s:
pūrṇaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ kṛtvā vratametadatandritaḥ ..
svargalokamavāpnoti sahasraparivatsarān .. 18 ..
3.28.d:
पूर्णं संवत्सरं कृत्वा व्रतमेतदतन्द्रितः ॥
स्वर्गलोकमवाप्नोति सहस्रपरिवत्सरान् ॥ 18 ॥
3.28.m: Having observed this vow for a complete year without slackening, / he attains the world of heaven for a thousand years.

3.28.s:
mānuṣyamāsādya tato rājā bhavati gahvare ..
vrataṃ kṛtvā mahārāja pūrṇaṃ saṃvatsaratrayam .. 19 ..
3.28.d:
मानुष्यमासाद्य ततो राजा भवति गह्वरे ॥
व्रतं कृत्वा महाराज पूर्णं संवत्सरत्रयम् ॥ 19 ॥
3.28.m: Then, having attained human birth, he becomes a king over a vast realm. / Having performed this vow, O great king, for three full years,

3.28.s:
pañcavarṣasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate ..
mānuṣyaṃ ca samāsādya rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ .. 3.136.20 ..
3.28.d:
पञ्चवर्षसहस्राणि स्वर्गलोके महीयते ॥
मानुष्यं च समासाद्य राजा भवति धार्मिकः ॥ 3.136.20 ॥
3.28.m: he is exalted in heaven for five thousand years. / And having attained human birth, he becomes a righteous king,

3.28.s:
vīro māṇḍalikaḥ śūraḥ paracakrabhayaṃkaraḥ ..
virogo darśanīyaśca subhago janavallabhaḥ .. 21 ..
3.28.d:
वीरो माण्डलिकः शूरः परचक्रभयंकरः ॥
विरोगो दर्शनीयश्च सुभगो जनवल्लभः ॥ 21 ॥
3.28.m: heroic, a ruler of a region, valiant, terrifying to hostile realms, / free from disease, handsome, fortunate, and beloved by the people.

3.28.s:
kṛtvā dvādaśavarṣāṇi vratametadanuttamam ..
vratāvasāne viprāṇāṃ sahasraṃ bhojayettataḥ .. 22 ..
3.28.d:
कृत्वा द्वादशवर्षाणि व्रतमेतदनुत्तमम् ॥
व्रतावसाने विप्राणां सहस्रं भोजयेत्ततः ॥ 22 ॥
3.28.m: Having performed this unsurpassed vow for twelve years, / at the end of the vow he should then feed a thousand brahmins.

3.28.s:
bhojyaṃ trimadhuraṃ peyaṃ dadyācchaktyā ca dakṣiṇām ..
tataḥ svargamavāpnoti varṣāṇāṃ ca śataṃ vratī .. 23 ..
3.28.d:
भोज्यं त्रिमधुरं पेयं दद्याच्छक्त्या च दक्षिणाम् ॥
ततः स्वर्गमवाप्नोति वर्षाणां च शतं व्रती ॥ 23 ॥
3.28.m: He should give food, the three sweet substances, drink, and a sacrificial fee according to his means. / Then the observer of the vow attains heaven for a hundred [divine] years.

3.28.s:
tato mānuṣyamāsādya rājā bhavati pārthivaḥ ..
pradīptacakro balavāndharmarājo janapriyaḥ .. 24 ..
3.28.d:
ततो मानुष्यमासाद्य राजा भवति पार्थिवः ॥
प्रदीप्तचक्रो बलवान्धर्मराजो जनप्रियः ॥ 24 ॥
3.28.m: Then, having attained human birth, he becomes an earthly king, / whose wheel of authority blazes, mighty, a king of righteousness, dear to the people.

3.28.s:
janmāntaraṃ samāsādya tato vipratvamāpnuyāt ..
tato brāhmaṇyamāsādya mokṣopāyaṃ ca vindati .. 25 ..
3.28.d:
जन्मान्तरं समासाद्य ततो विप्रत्वमाप्नुयात् ॥
ततो ब्राह्मण्यमासाद्य मोक्षोपायं च विन्दति ॥ 25 ॥
3.28.m: In another birth, he would then attain the state of a brahmin. / Then, having attained brahminhood, he finds the means to liberation.

3.28.s:
ārādhanaṃ te kathitaṃ mayaitadviṣṇostridehasya mahānubhāva ..
ārādhito yena jagatpradhāna kāmānabhīṣṭānviduṣo dadāti .. 26 ..
3.137
.. mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi viṣṇumūrtivrataṃ tava ..
dvidhā tu devadevasya mṛrtirbhavati yādava .. 1 ..
ghorā cānyā śivā cānyā ghorā bhavati pāvakaḥ ..
śivā cāmbupatiryasmādagnīṣomātmakaṃ jagat .. 2 ..
dvidhā ghorā vinirdiṣṭā dvidhā saumyā tataḥ punaḥ ..
ghorā vahniśca sūryaśca saumyā somajalādhipo .. 3 ..
teṣāṃ ca pūjanaṃ kāryaṃ prativatprabhṛti kramāt ..
śuklapakṣādathārabhya phālgunasya dvijottama ..4..
ādityaṃ pūjayedrājā prathamehni paraḥ śuciḥ ..
dvitīyehni tathā vahni tṛtīyehni jalādhipam.. 5 ..
caturthehni śaśāṃkaṃ ca yathāvanmānavottama ..
teṣāṃ tu rūpanirmāṇaṃ kṛtvā tānarcayedbudhaḥ ..6..
3.28.d:
आराधनं ते कथितं मयैतद्विष्णोस्त्रिदेहस्य महानुभाव ॥
आराधितो येन जगत्प्रधान कामानभीष्टान्विदुषो ददाति ॥ 26 ॥
3.137
॥ मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि विष्णुमूर्तिव्रतं तव ॥
द्विधा तु देवदेवस्य मृर्तिर्भवति यादव ॥ 1 ॥
घोरा चान्या शिवा चान्या घोरा भवति पावकः ॥
शिवा चाम्बुपतिर्यस्मादग्नीषोमात्मकं जगत् ॥ 2 ॥
द्विधा घोरा विनिर्दिष्टा द्विधा सौम्या ततः पुनः ॥
घोरा वह्निश्च सूर्यश्च सौम्या सोमजलाधिपो ॥ 3 ॥
तेषां च पूजनं कार्यं प्रतिवत्प्रभृति क्रमात् ॥
शुक्लपक्षादथारभ्य फाल्गुनस्य द्विजोत्तम ॥4॥
आदित्यं पूजयेद्राजा प्रथमेह्नि परः शुचिः ॥
द्वितीयेह्नि तथा वह्नि तृतीयेह्नि जलाधिपम्॥ 5 ॥
चतुर्थेह्नि शशांकं च यथावन्मानवोत्तम ॥
तेषां तु रूपनिर्माणं कृत्वा तानर्चयेद्बुधः ॥6॥
3.28.m:
This worship of Viṣṇu of three bodies has been told to you by me, O illustrious one; / worshipped through it, the chief lord of the universe grants the desired wishes to the wise.
Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Further, I will explain to you the vow of Viṣṇu’s forms. / The form of the god of gods is twofold, O Yādava:
one is terrible, and the other is auspicious; the terrible one is the Purifier [Fire], / and the auspicious one is the Lord of Waters [Soma], since the universe consists of Agni and Soma.
The terrible is taught as twofold, and again the gentle is twofold: / the terrible are Fire and Sun, and the gentle are Soma and the Lord of Waters.
Worship of these is to be performed in order, beginning from the first day, / starting from the bright fortnight of Phālguna, O best of the twice-born.
On the first day, exceedingly pure, the king should worship the Sun; / on the second day, Fire; on the third day, the Lord of Waters;
and on the fourth day, the Moon, according to rule, O best of men. / Having made images of these, the wise man should worship them

with an abundance of perfumes, garlands, obeisance, incense, lamps, and food. / On the first day, he should bathe with sweet flag and turmeric;
on the second, O tiger among the Yadus, an auspicious bath with myrobalan fruits; / on the third, with priyaṅgu; and on the fourth, with white mustard.
With wheat, sesame, rice, and barley respectively by day, / an oblation is to be performed, O knower of dharma; and now hear the sacrificial fee:
saffron, red cloth, sandalwood, and a parasol. / In this [vow], subsistence should be maintained each day solely with milk.
Having observed this vow for a complete year, O best of men, / he obtains the fruit of a sacrifice endowed with all desires.
And he goes to the world of heaven in an aerial chariot having the colour of the sun. / Having dwelt there for a very long time, he is born into an exalted family.
Having attained human birth, he becomes free from disease, a lord of the earth who has conquered hostile factions, / abiding in dharma, devoted to truth, disciplined, with senses subdued, delightful to all people.

3.28.m:
Mārkaṇḍeya said: / I will declare to you this other vow of the fourfold form: / Śakra, Kīnāśa [Yama], Varuṇa, and the Lord of Wealth [Kubera], O best of Yadus.
Vāsudeva, the Lord of the Universe, is taught as having four forms. / Having made images of them, the wise man should worship them
with an abundance of perfumes, garlands, obeisance, incense, lamps, and food. / On the first day of the bright fortnight of Caitra, he should worship the Lord of the Thirty [Indra];
on the second day, the god Yama; on the third, the Lord of Waters; / and on the fourth day, the Lord of Wealth. Each day he should bathe,
having reached a riverbank, beholding the deity each day in turn. / The oblation should be made with barley, sesame seeds, ghee, and sesame mixed with rice grains,
and [he should offer] red, yellow, black, and white cloth in the order of the days. / Having observed this auspicious vow for a full year, a man / attains the celestial world for as long as fourteen Indras endure.

3.28.m:
Having attained human birth, he becomes free from disease, a lord of the earth who has conquered hostile factions, / delightful to people, naturally fortunate, and from that he further attains brahminhood.
3.139
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
I will tell you of another four-form vow:
Viṣṇu, the Earth, the Sky, and Brahmā are his four forms.
Having fashioned their forms, one should then worship them / with an abundance of perfume, garlands, prostrations, incense, lamps, and food.
On the first day of the bright half of Caitra, one should worship the god Viṣṇu; / on the second and following days, O knower of dharma, the Earth, [the Sky], and the Grandfather.
All the other procedures should be as stated in the previous vow. / Having performed this vow, a man attains the heavenly world.
Attaining human birth, he becomes free from disease, delighted in dharma, endowed with wealth, / endowed with riches, beauty, and happiness, pleasing to the people, and triumphant over his enemies.

मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
इदमन्यत्प्रवक्ष्यामि चतुर्मूर्तिव्रतं तव ॥
बलं ज्ञानं तथैश्वर्यं शक्तिश्च यदुनन्दन ॥ 1 ॥
विख्यातं देवदेवस्य तस्य मूर्तिचतुष्टयम् ॥
यदेव रूपं धर्मस्य बलस्योक्तं तदेव तु ॥ 2 ॥
रूपं ज्ञानस्य ते प्रोक्तं नरसिंहं तथा नृप ॥
रुद्ररूपमथैश्वर्यं कथितं ते मया नृप ॥ 3 ॥
शक्तिर्वराहः कथितो देवो मधुनिषूदनः ॥
एवमेतन्मुखात्प्रोक्तं चतुर्मूर्तिधरस्य ते ॥ 4 ॥

ऐश्वर्यं पश्चिमं वक्त्रं रौद्रं पापहरं तथा ॥

3.28.m:
3.140
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
I will tell you of another four-form vow:
Strength, knowledge, sovereignty, and power, O joy of the Yadus,
are known as the four forms of that god of gods. / The form of dharma has indeed been spoken of as that of strength;
the form of knowledge has been declared to you as Narasiṃha, O king; / and sovereignty has been described to you by me as the form of Rudra, O king.
Power has been declared to be the Boar, the god who is the slayer of Madhu. / Thus from each face of him who bears the four forms has it been declared to you.
His eastern face, representing strength, is the face of Vāsudeva. / They know the southern face, representing knowledge, to be the god Saṃkarṣaṇa.
The western face, representing sovereignty, belongs to Rudra and removes sins; / and the northern face is declared to be the Boar, Aniruddha.
Having fasted for three nights, one should worship the eastern face in Caitra; / likewise in the month of Vaiśākha one should worship the southern face; / in Jyeṣṭha the western face, and in Āṣāḍha likewise the northern.

व्रतमेतन्नरः कृत्वा पूर्णं मासचतुष्टयम् ॥
पारणे प्रथमे प्राप्ते भवतीति विनिश्चयः॥ 3.140.10 ॥
पारणं प्रथमं कृत्वा स्वर्गलोके महीयते॥
दशवर्षसहस्राणि स्वर्गं भुक्त्वा यथोदितम् ॥ 11 ॥
सौम्यादिषु च यामेषु द्वितीयं पारणं भवेत् ॥
द्वितीयं पारणं कृत्वा भोजयेद्ब्राह्मणाञ्शुचिः ॥
भोजनं गोरसप्रायं मृद्वीकाशर्करायुतम् ॥ 12॥
प्राप्ते तृतीये द्विजपारणे च प्राप्नोति देवस्य सलोकतां सः ॥
स्वर्गेन्दुलोकौ च तथोक्तकालं भुक्त्वा सुखी सर्वसमृद्धिकामः ॥ 13 ॥
3.28.m:
In the month of Caitra, one should give what is useful for the household to a twice-born; / in Vaiśākha, one should give what is useful for battle, O best of the Yādavas;
likewise in Jyeṣṭha, one should give what is useful for sacrifice to a twice-born; / and in the month of Āṣāḍha, one should likewise give what is useful for the sacred rite.
When a man has observed this vow for four full months, / when the first conclusion is reached, he becomes [sanctified]—such is the certainty.
Having performed the first conclusion, he is honoured in the heavenly world; / having enjoyed heaven for ten thousand years as stated,
in the gentle and other watches of the day, the second conclusion takes place. / Having performed the second conclusion, pure, he should feed brahmins / with food consisting mostly of milk-products, along with raisins and sugar.
And when the third conclusion for the twice-born is reached, he attains residence in the same realm as the god; / and having enjoyed the worlds of heaven and the Moon for the stated time, happy, he has all his desires fulfilled.

इदमन्यत्प्रवक्ष्यामि चतुर्मूर्तिव्रतं तव ॥
विद्याकामेन कर्तव्यं नरेण सुविपश्चिता ॥ 1 ॥
3.29.m:
3.141
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
I will tell you of another four-form vow, / to be observed by an intelligent person who desires sacred knowledge.

3.29.s:
bahiḥ snānaṃ naraḥ kṛtvā kṛtaṛgvedapūjanaḥ ..
ṛgvedaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ māsamātramatandritaḥ .. 2 ..
3.29.d:
बहिः स्नानं नरः कृत्वा कृतऋग्वेदपूजनः ॥
ऋग्वेदं शृणुयान्नित्यं मासमात्रमतन्द्रितः ॥ 2 ॥
3.29.m: Having bathed outside and worshipped the Ṛgveda, / a person should listen to the Ṛgveda daily for just one month without indolence.

3.29.s:
caitrādārabhya dharmajñaḥ nityaṃ naktāśano dvijaḥ ..
yasmācchrutaṃ dvijāttasya jyeṣṭhasya caramehani .. 3 ..
3.29.d:
चैत्रादारभ्य धर्मज्ञः नित्यं नक्ताशनो द्विजः ॥
यस्माच्छ्रुतं द्विजात्तस्य ज्येष्ठस्य चरमेहनि ॥ 3 ॥
3.29.m: Beginning from Caitra, the twice-born who knows dharma should eat only at night. / To that senior twice-born from whom he heard it, on the final day,

3.29.s:
vāsoyugaṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca tathā dhenuṃ payasvinīma ..
ghṛtapūrṇaṃ kāṃsyapātraṃ sahiraṇyaṃ ca dakṣiṇā .. 4 ..
3.29.d:
वासोयुगं हिरण्यं च तथा धेनुं पयस्विनीम ॥
घृतपूर्णं कांस्यपात्रं सहिरण्यं च दक्षिणा ॥ 4 ॥
3.29.m: a pair of garments, gold, and a milch cow [should be given]; / a bronze vessel full of clarified butter with gold is the sacrificial fee.

3.29.s:
āṣāḍhādiṣu māseṣu yajurvedavrataṃ bhaveta ..
āśvinādiṣu māseṣu sāmavedavrataṃ bhavet .. 5 ..
3.29.d:
आषाढादिषु मासेषु यजुर्वेदव्रतं भवेत ॥
आश्विनादिषु मासेषु सामवेदव्रतं भवेत् ॥ 5 ॥
3.29.m: In the months beginning with Āṣāḍha, there should be the vow of the Yajurveda; / in the months beginning with Āśvina, there should be the vow of the Sāmaveda.

3.29.s:
tathā sarvavrataṃ nāma pauṣādiṣu vidhīyate ..
sarveṣu sarvaṃ kartavyamṛgvedavratakīrtitam .. 6 ..
3.29.d:
तथा सर्वव्रतं नाम पौषादिषु विधीयते ॥
सर्वेषु सर्वं कर्तव्यमृग्वेदव्रतकीर्तितम् ॥ 6 ॥
3.29.m: Likewise, that named the vow of all [the Vedas] is prescribed in [the months] beginning with Pauṣa; / in all of them, everything declared for the vow of the Ṛgveda should be performed.

3.29.s:
vedātmano vāsudevasya pūjāṃ kṛtvā naro drādaśavatsarāṇi ..
viṣṇolokaṃ yāti loke viśiṣṭaṃ yastaṃ prāptaḥ sarvaduḥkhaṃ jahāti .. 7 ..
3.142
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
idamanyatpravakṣyāmi caturmūrtivrataṃ tava ..* caturvyūha
sarvātmanāṃ tu kartavyā yathā pūjā jagadguroḥ..
caitraśuklacaturthyāṃ tu sopavāso jitendriyaḥ .. 1 ..
caturthyāṃ vāsudevasya kṛtvā saṃpūjanaṃ śubhama ..
kāñcanaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāddvijāya brahmacāriṇe .. 2 ..
tathā saṅkarṣaṇaṃ devaṃ pūjayitvā jagadgurum ..
vaiśākhe tu gṛhasthāya dadyācchayyāṃ susaṃskṛtām .. 3 ..
saṃpūjya devaṃ pradyumnaṃ jyeṣṭhe māsi yathāvidhi ..
vanasthāya tathā dadyātphalamūlaṃ sagorasam .. 4 ..
aniruddhaṃ tathāṣāḍhe pūjayitvā jagadgurum ..
dadyādalābupātraṃ ca yogasthāya dvijātaye .. 5 ..
3.29.d:
वेदात्मनो वासुदेवस्य पूजां कृत्वा नरो द्रादशवत्सराणि ॥
विष्णोलोकं याति लोके विशिष्टं यस्तं प्राप्तः सर्वदुःखं जहाति ॥ 7 ॥
3.142
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
इदमन्यत्प्रवक्ष्यामि चतुर्मूर्तिव्रतं तव ॥* चतुर्व्यूह
सर्वात्मनां तु कर्तव्या यथा पूजा जगद्गुरोः॥
चैत्रशुक्लचतुर्थ्यां तु सोपवासो जितेन्द्रियः ॥ 1 ॥
चतुर्थ्यां वासुदेवस्य कृत्वा संपूजनं शुभम ॥
काञ्चनं दक्षिणां दद्याद्द्विजाय ब्रह्मचारिणे ॥ 2 ॥
तथा सङ्कर्षणं देवं पूजयित्वा जगद्गुरुम् ॥
वैशाखे तु गृहस्थाय दद्याच्छय्यां सुसंस्कृताम् ॥ 3 ॥
संपूज्य देवं प्रद्युम्नं ज्येष्ठे मासि यथाविधि ॥
वनस्थाय तथा दद्यात्फलमूलं सगोरसम् ॥ 4 ॥
अनिरुद्धं तथाषाढे पूजयित्वा जगद्गुरुम् ॥
दद्यादलाबुपात्रं च योगस्थाय द्विजातये ॥ 5 ॥
3.29.m:
Having performed the worship of Vāsudeva, who is the self of the Vedas, for twelve years, / a person goes to the world of Viṣṇu, preeminent in the world; and having reached it, he leaves behind all suffering.
3.142
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
I will tell you of another four-form vow, / how the worship of the teacher of the world, who is the self of all, should be performed:
Fasting, with subdued senses, on the fourth day of the bright half of Caitra,
having performed the auspicious worship of Vāsudeva on the fourth day, / he should give gold as a sacrificial fee to a celibate student who is a twice-born.
Likewise, having worshipped the god Saṃkarṣaṇa, the teacher of the world, / in Vaiśākha, he should give a well-prepared bed to a householder.
Having duly worshipped the god Pradyumna in the month of Jyeṣṭha, / he should give fruits and roots along with milk-products to a forest-dweller.
Likewise, having worshipped Aniruddha, the teacher of the world, in Āṣāḍha, / he should give a gourd-vessel to a twice-born established in yoga.

3.29.s:
ityevaṃ pāraṇaṃ proktaṃ svargaloke mahīyate ..
dvitīye pāraṇe prāpte śakraloke mahīyate .. 6 ..
sālokyamāyātyatha keśavasya prāpte tṛtīye tvatha pāraṇe ca ..
ityāśramākhyaṃ vratamuttamaṃ te mayeti kalmaṣanāśakāri .. 7 ..
3.143
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
idamanyatpravakṣyāmi caturmūrtivrataṃ tava ..
caturātmā hariḥ proktaścatvārastu hutāśanāḥ .. 1 ..
āhitāgnirdvijo yasya vidyate'gnicatuṣṭayam ..
sopavāsaścaturthyāṃ tu śuklapakṣasya phālgune .. 2..
abhyarcya caturātmānaṃ vāsudevamatandritaḥ ..
tasmai dadyāddvijendrāya tilaprasthāni ṣoḍaśa .. 3 ..
suvarṇasya suvarṇaṃ ca vastraṃ ghṛtatulāmapi ..
evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ kṛtvā vratametadatandritaḥ ..4 ..
sarvakāmasamṛddhasya yajñasya phalamaśnute ..
vimānenārkavarṇena svargalokaṃ ca gacchati .. 5 ..
3.29.d:
इत्येवं पारणं प्रोक्तं स्वर्गलोके महीयते ॥
द्वितीये पारणे प्राप्ते शक्रलोके महीयते ॥ 6 ॥
सालोक्यमायात्यथ केशवस्य प्राप्ते तृतीये त्वथ पारणे च ॥
इत्याश्रमाख्यं व्रतमुत्तमं ते मयेति कल्मषनाशकारि ॥ 7 ॥
3.143
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
इदमन्यत्प्रवक्ष्यामि चतुर्मूर्तिव्रतं तव ॥
चतुरात्मा हरिः प्रोक्तश्चत्वारस्तु हुताशनाः ॥ 1 ॥
आहिताग्निर्द्विजो यस्य विद्यतेऽग्निचतुष्टयम् ॥
सोपवासश्चतुर्थ्यां तु शुक्लपक्षस्य फाल्गुने ॥ 2॥
अभ्यर्च्य चतुरात्मानं वासुदेवमतन्द्रितः ॥
तस्मै दद्याद्द्विजेन्द्राय तिलप्रस्थानि षोडश ॥ 3 ॥
सुवर्णस्य सुवर्णं च वस्त्रं घृततुलामपि ॥
एवं संवत्सरं कृत्वा व्रतमेतदतन्द्रितः ॥4 ॥
सर्वकामसमृद्धस्य यज्ञस्य फलमश्नुते ॥
विमानेनार्कवर्णेन स्वर्गलोकं च गच्छति ॥ 5 ॥
3.29.m:
Thus is the conclusion described; he is honoured in the heavenly world. / When the second conclusion is reached, he is honoured in the world of Śakra.
And when the third conclusion is reached, he attains residence in the same realm as Keśava. / Thus have I told you this excellent vow named after the stages of life, which destroys all impurities.
3.143
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
I will tell you of another four-form vow:
Hari is declared to be fourfold in nature, and the sacrificial fires are four.
A twice-born who has established the sacred fires, in whom the four fires are present, / fasting on the fourth day of the bright fortnight of Phālguna,
Worshipping Vāsudeva of fourfold self with unflagging zeal, / he should give sixteen prasthas of sesame to that lord among twice-borns,
a suvarṇa of gold, clothing, and a tulā of ghee. / Having performed this vow with unflagging zeal for one year in this manner,
he obtains the fruit of a sacrifice complete with all desires, / and travels to the heavenly world in a sun-colored aerial chariot.

3.29.s:
mānuṣo dīptatejāḥ syāddīptāgniḥ pramadāpriyaḥ ..
ripūñjayati saṃgrāme dhanavāṃśca tathā bhavet .. 6 ..
ye tvagnayo vai caturaḥ pradiṣṭāḥ sa vāsudevaḥ kathitaścaturdhā ..
yaḥ pūjayedbrāhmaṇamāhitā'gniṃ devaḥ sa tenāpyatha pūjitaḥ syāt .. ..7 ..
3.144
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
idamanyatpravakṣyāmi caturmūrtivrataṃ tava ..
caitraśuklasamārambhe prathame'hni pūjayeta .. 1 ..
kṛtaṃ śuklena sarveṇa gandhamālyādinā dvijaḥ ..
dvitīye'hani raktena tathā tretāṃ tu pūjayet .. 2 ..
tṛtīye'hani pītena dvāparaṃ pūjayedbudhaḥ ..
caturthe'hani kṛṣṇena tiṣyaṃ saṃpūjayedyugam .. 3 ..
siddhārthakaiḥ kuṃkumena tathaiva ca haridrayā ..
tathaivāmalakasnānamācareddivasakramāt .. 4 ..
siddhārthakākṣatatilairghṛtena juhuyāttathā ..
muktāphalaṃ tathā vajraṃ padmarāgaṃ ca yādava .. .. 5 ..
3.29.d:
मानुषो दीप्ततेजाः स्याद्दीप्ताग्निः प्रमदाप्रियः ॥
रिपूञ्जयति संग्रामे धनवांश्च तथा भवेत् ॥ 6 ॥
ये त्वग्नयो वै चतुरः प्रदिष्टाः स वासुदेवः कथितश्चतुर्धा ॥
यः पूजयेद्ब्राह्मणमाहिताऽग्निं देवः स तेनाप्यथ पूजितः स्यात् ॥ ॥7 ॥
3.144
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
इदमन्यत्प्रवक्ष्यामि चतुर्मूर्तिव्रतं तव ॥
चैत्रशुक्लसमारम्भे प्रथमेऽह्नि पूजयेत ॥ 1 ॥
कृतं शुक्लेन सर्वेण गन्धमाल्यादिना द्विजः ॥
द्वितीयेऽहनि रक्तेन तथा त्रेतां तु पूजयेत् ॥ 2 ॥
तृतीयेऽहनि पीतेन द्वापरं पूजयेद्बुधः ॥
चतुर्थेऽहनि कृष्णेन तिष्यं संपूजयेद्युगम् ॥ 3 ॥
सिद्धार्थकैः कुंकुमेन तथैव च हरिद्रया ॥
तथैवामलकस्नानमाचरेद्दिवसक्रमात् ॥ 4 ॥
सिद्धार्थकाक्षततिलैर्घृतेन जुहुयात्तथा ॥
मुक्ताफलं तथा वज्रं पद्मरागं च यादव ॥ ॥ 5 ॥
3.29.m:
As a mortal, he becomes blazing in splendor, possessed of blazing digestive fire, dear to women; / he conquers enemies in battle and likewise becomes wealthy.
Those four fires that have been declared are indeed Vāsudeva, spoken of fourfold; / one who worships a brahmin who maintains the sacred fires, by him that god is also worshipped.
3.144 / Mārkaṇḍeya said: / I will declare to you another vow of the four forms. / At the beginning of the bright fortnight of Caitra, on the first day, a twice-born should worship
the Kṛta age with all white fragrant pastes, garlands, and so forth; / on the second day, he should likewise worship the Tretā age with red;
on the third day, the wise person should worship the Dvāpara age with yellow; / on the fourth day, he should worship the Kali age with black.
With white mustard seeds, with saffron, and likewise with turmeric, / and likewise with emblic myrobalan, he should bathe in the order of the days.
He should offer oblations with white mustard seeds, unbroken grains, sesame, and ghee; / and, O descendant of Yadu, a pearl, a diamond, a ruby,

3.29.s:
indranīlaṃ tathā dadyādvipreṣu divasakramāt ..
kṣīreṇa prāṇayātrāṃ tu kuryātpratyahameva tu .. 6 ..
kṛtvā vrataṃ vatsarametadekaṃ caturyugaṃ modati nākapṛṣṭhe ..
saṃpūjya devaṃ yugamūrtisaṃjñaṃ caturyugaṃ śāsti mahīṃ samagrām ..7..
3.145
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
idamanyatpravakṣyāmi caturmūrtivrataṃ tava ..
nityaṃ caturṣu māseṣu śrāvaṇādyeṣu yādava .. 1 ..
catuḥsāgaracihnāni pūrṇakumbhāni pūjayeta ..
caturātmā harirjñeyaḥ sāgarātmā vicakṣaṇaiḥ ..

naktaṃ ca prāśanaṃ kuryyātsatataṃ tailavarjitam .. 4 ..
3.29.d:
इन्द्रनीलं तथा दद्याद्विप्रेषु दिवसक्रमात् ॥
क्षीरेण प्राणयात्रां तु कुर्यात्प्रत्यहमेव तु ॥ 6 ॥
कृत्वा व्रतं वत्सरमेतदेकं चतुर्युगं मोदति नाकपृष्ठे ॥
संपूज्य देवं युगमूर्तिसंज्ञं चतुर्युगं शास्ति महीं समग्राम् ॥7॥
3.145
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
इदमन्यत्प्रवक्ष्यामि चतुर्मूर्तिव्रतं तव ॥
नित्यं चतुर्षु मासेषु श्रावणाद्येषु यादव ॥ 1 ॥
चतुःसागरचिह्नानि पूर्णकुम्भानि पूजयेत ॥
चतुरात्मा हरिर्ज्ञेयः सागरात्मा विचक्षणैः ॥
स्नानं समाचरेन्नित्यं नदीतोयेषु यादव ॥ 2 ॥
होमं च प्रत्यहं कुर्याद् गव्येन पयसा तथा ॥
तानि कुम्भानि विप्रेभ्यः प्रत्यहं विनिवेदयेत् ॥ 3 ॥
सोपहाराणि धर्मज्ञ भक्त्या शक्त्या तथैव च ॥
नक्तं च प्राशनं कुर्य्यात्सततं तैलवर्जितम् ॥ 4 ॥
3.29.m:
and a sapphire he should give to the brahmins in the order of the days; / and he should sustain his life daily with milk alone.
Having performed this vow for one year, he rejoices on the back of heaven for four ages; / having worshipped the god designated as the form of the ages, he rules the entire earth for four ages.
3.145 / Mārkaṇḍeya said: / I will declare to you another vow of the four forms. / Constantly during the four months beginning with Śrāvaṇa, O descendant of Yadu,
he should worship filled jars marked with the emblems of the four oceans. / Hari is to be known by the wise as fourfold, as having the nature of the oceans. / He should constantly bathe in river waters, O descendant of Yadu,
and perform oblations daily with cow's milk; / he should offer those jars daily to brahmins
with gifts, O knower of dharma, with devotion and according to his capacity; / and he should eat only at night, always avoiding oil.

कार्तिकस्यावसानेऽह्नि भोजयित्वा द्विजोत्तमान् ॥
धेनुं दत्त्वा च विप्राय नाकपृष्ठे महीयते ॥
सर्वकामसमृद्धस्य यज्ञस्य फलमश्नुते ॥5॥
मानुष्यमासाद्य महीपतिः स्याद्भुक्त्वा महीं सागरमेखलान्ताम् ॥
तत्रापि धर्मस्य पतिर्निविष्टो भवत्यरोगश्च बलेन युक्तः ॥ 6 ॥
3.29.m:
Having fed the foremost of twice-borns on the final day of Kārttika / and given a milch cow to a brahmin, he is honored on the back of heaven; / he obtains the fruit of a sacrifice complete with all desires.
Attaining human birth, he becomes an earth-ruler, having enjoyed the earth bounded by the oceans as her girdle; / even there, established as a lord of dharma, he is free from disease and endowed with strength.

3.30.m: 3.146 / Mārkaṇḍeya said: / I will declare to you another vow of the four forms. / Garuḍa is the banner-emblem of Vāsudeva, and a palmyra palm of Saṃkarṣaṇa;

3.30.s:
pradyumnasya tathā cihnaṃ makaro vyāditānanaḥ..
devo'niruddho dharmajña ṛṣyaketuḥ prakīrtataḥ..2..
3.30.d:
प्रद्युम्नस्य तथा चिह्नं मकरो व्यादिताननः॥
देवोऽनिरुद्धो धर्मज्ञ ऋष्यकेतुः प्रकीर्ततः॥2॥
3.30.m: the banner-emblem of Pradyumna is a makara with gaping mouth; / the god Aniruddha, O knower of dharma, is renowned as having a white-footed antelope banner.

3.30.s:
pītaṃ nīlaṃ tathā śvetaṃ raktaṃ ca yadunandana..
teṣāṃ tu kathitaṃ vāsaḥ patākā tādṛgiṣyate..3..
3.30.d:
पीतं नीलं तथा श्वेतं रक्तं च यदुनन्दन॥
तेषां तु कथितं वासः पताका तादृगिष्यते॥3॥
3.30.m: Yellow, blue, white, and red, O delight of the Yadus, / are declared to be their garments; their flags are considered to be of the same [color].

3.30.s:
yasya devasya yaccihnaṃ sa cātmā nāma kīrtitaḥ ..
patākā yādṛśī yasya vasanaṃ tasya tādṛśam.. 4 ..
3.30.d:
यस्य देवस्य यच्चिह्नं स चात्मा नाम कीर्तितः ॥
पताका यादृशी यस्य वसनं तस्य तादृशम्॥ 4 ॥
3.30.m: Whatever emblem belongs to which god, that is declared as his nature; / whatever flag belongs to him, such is his garment.

3.30.s:
caitre tu pratyahaṃ māsi garuḍaṃ pūjayennaraḥ ..
pītena gaṃdhanaivedyamālyavastrādinā dvijaḥ..5..
3.30.d:
चैत्रे तु प्रत्यहं मासि गरुडं पूजयेन्नरः ॥
पीतेन गंधनैवेद्यमाल्यवस्त्रादिना द्विजः॥5॥
3.30.m: A twice-born man should worship Garuḍa daily in the month of Caitra / with yellow fragrant paste, food-offerings, garlands, garments, and so forth;

3.30.s:
vaiśākhe ca tathā māsi tālaṃ saṃpūjayetsadā ..
nīlena gaṃdhanaivedyamālyavastrādinā dvijaḥ..6..
3.30.d:
वैशाखे च तथा मासि तालं संपूजयेत्सदा ॥
नीलेन गंधनैवेद्यमाल्यवस्त्रादिना द्विजः॥6॥
3.30.m: and in the month of Vaiśākha, a twice-born should constantly worship the palmyra palm / with blue fragrant paste, food-offerings, garlands, garments, and so forth;

3.30.s:
ṛṣyaṃ saṃpūjayeddevaṃ māsyāṣāḍhe yathāvidhi ..
raktena gandhanaivedyamālyavastrādinā dvijaḥ..7.. .
3.30.d:
ऋष्यं संपूजयेद्देवं मास्याषाढे यथाविधि ॥
रक्तेन गन्धनैवेद्यमाल्यवस्त्रादिना द्विजः॥7॥ ।
3.30.m: in the month of Āṣāḍha, a twice-born should duly worship the god antelope / with red fragrant paste, food-offerings, garlands, garments, and so forth.

3.30.s:
bahiḥ snānaṃ tathā kuryādvahnisaṃpūjanaṃ tataḥ ..
nityaṃ ca kuryāddharmajña tathā brāhmaṇatarpaṇam .. 8 ..
3.30.d:
बहिः स्नानं तथा कुर्याद्वह्निसंपूजनं ततः ॥
नित्यं च कुर्याद्धर्मज्ञ तथा ब्राह्मणतर्पणम् ॥ 8 ॥
3.30.m: He should bathe outside and then perform the worship of the fire; / and, O knower of dharma, he should daily make propitiation of brahmins;

3.30.s:
prāṇayātrā tathā kuryāduktaṃ tailavivarjitam ..
adhaḥśāyī tathā ca syād brahmacārī tathā bhavet .. 9 ..
3.30.d:
प्राणयात्रा तथा कुर्यादुक्तं तैलविवर्जितम् ॥
अधःशायी तथा च स्याद् ब्रह्मचारी तथा भवेत् ॥ 9 ॥
3.30.m: he should sustain his life as prescribed, without oil; / he should sleep on the ground and remain celibate.
He should perform this vow constantly for four months. / On the final day of Āṣāḍha, he should worship brahmins according to his means,

3.30.s:
vastrāṇyarthāni dharmajña dadyādvipreṣu dakṣiṇām ..
kṛtvaikaṃ pāraṇaṃ rājansvargaloke mahīyate .. 11 ..
3.30.d:
वस्त्राण्यर्थानि धर्मज्ञ दद्याद्विप्रेषु दक्षिणाम् ॥
कृत्वैकं पारणं राजन्स्वर्गलोके महीयते ॥ 11 ॥
3.30.m: and give garments and wealth as sacrificial fees to brahmins, O knower of dharma. / Having performed one conclusion of the vow, O king, he is honored in the heavenly world;

3.30.s:
dvitīyaṃ pāraṇaṃ kṛtvā śakraloke mahīyate ..
tṛtīyaṃ pāraṇaṃ kṛtvā brahmaloke mahīyate .. 12 ..
3.30.d:
द्वितीयं पारणं कृत्वा शक्रलोके महीयते ॥
तृतीयं पारणं कृत्वा ब्रह्मलोके महीयते ॥ 12 ॥
3.30.m: having performed a second conclusion, he is honored in Śakra's world; / having performed a third conclusion, he is honored in the world of Brahmā;

3.30.s:
kṛtvā pāraṇaṣaṭkaṃ tu rudraloke mahīyate ..
viṣṇulokamavāpnoti kṛtvā dvādaśapāraṇam .. 13 ..
3.30.d:
कृत्वा पारणषट्कं तु रुद्रलोके महीयते ॥
विष्णुलोकमवाप्नोति कृत्वा द्वादशपारणम् ॥ 13 ॥
3.30.m: having performed six conclusions, he is honored in Rudra's world; / having performed twelve conclusions, he attains the world of Viṣṇu.

3.30.s:
dhvajavrataṃ dvādaśavatsarāṇi kṛtvā naro bhārgavavaṃśamukhya ..
sāyujyamāyāti janārdanasya devasya viṣṇoḥ parameśvarasya .. 14 ..
3.147
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
idamanyatpravakṣyāmi caturmūrtivrataṃ tava ..
īśānaṃ ca tathā vahniṃ virūpākṣaṃ samīraṇam .. 1..
vijñeyaṃ yaduśārdūla devamūrticatuṣṭayam ..
teṣāṃ tu rūpanirmāṇaṃ kṛtvā tānarcayedbudhaḥ .. 2 ..
gandhamālyanamaskāradhūpadīpānnasaṃpadā ..
caitraśukle mahābhāgaṃ pratipatprabhṛti kramāt .. 3 ..
bhaumanādeyatāḍākasārasaiḥ snānamācaret ..
dadhnā tilairyavairhomo ghṛtena ca tathā bhavet .. 4 ..
karpūrakuṅkumaṃ caiva tathaivāgurucaṃdane ..
brāhmaṇeṣu pradātavyaṃ tathā rājandina kramāta .. 5 ..
dinatrayaṃ tathāśnīyātsāyaṃprātarayācitam ..
dinamekaṃ tathāśnīyādbrahmacārī narottama .. 6 ..
3.30.d:
ध्वजव्रतं द्वादशवत्सराणि कृत्वा नरो भार्गववंशमुख्य ॥
सायुज्यमायाति जनार्दनस्य देवस्य विष्णोः परमेश्वरस्य ॥ 14 ॥
3.147
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
इदमन्यत्प्रवक्ष्यामि चतुर्मूर्तिव्रतं तव ॥
ईशानं च तथा वह्निं विरूपाक्षं समीरणम् ॥ 1॥
विज्ञेयं यदुशार्दूल देवमूर्तिचतुष्टयम् ॥
तेषां तु रूपनिर्माणं कृत्वा तानर्चयेद्बुधः ॥ 2 ॥
गन्धमाल्यनमस्कारधूपदीपान्नसंपदा ॥
चैत्रशुक्ले महाभागं प्रतिपत्प्रभृति क्रमात् ॥ 3 ॥
भौमनादेयताडाकसारसैः स्नानमाचरेत् ॥
दध्ना तिलैर्यवैर्होमो घृतेन च तथा भवेत् ॥ 4 ॥
कर्पूरकुङ्कुमं चैव तथैवागुरुचंदने ॥
ब्राह्मणेषु प्रदातव्यं तथा राजन्दिन क्रमात ॥ 5 ॥
दिनत्रयं तथाश्नीयात्सायंप्रातरयाचितम् ॥
दिनमेकं तथाश्नीयाद्ब्रह्मचारी नरोत्तम ॥ 6 ॥
3.30.m:
Having observed the banner-vow for twelve years, a man, O foremost of Bhṛgu's lineage, / attains union with Janārdana, the god Viṣṇu, the supreme lord.
3.147 / Mārkaṇḍeya said: / I will declare to you another vow of the four forms: / Īśāna, Agni, Virūpākṣa, and the wind,
are to be understood as the four divine forms, O tiger among the Yadus. / Having fashioned their figures, the wise person should worship them
with an abundance of fragrant paste, garlands, obeisances, incense, lamps, and food, / in the bright fortnight of Caitra, O fortunate one, beginning from the first lunar day in due order.
He should bathe in waters from the earth, rivers, tanks, and natural lakes; / oblations of curd, sesame, barley, and ghee should be offered.
And camphor, saffron, and likewise agallochum and sandalwood / should be given to brahmins, O king, in the order of the days.
Likewise, for three days one should eat unbegged food in the evening and the morning. / For one day one should eat thus, living as a celibate student, O best of men.

3.30.s:
evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ puruṣasattama ..
sarvakāmasamṛddhasya yajñasya phalamaśnute .. 7 ..
mānuṣyamāsādya bhavatyarogo vasundhareśo vijitāripakṣaḥ ..
janmāntare syāddvijavaryamukhyo vedaprasakto bahuyajñayājī..8..
3.148
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
idamanyatpravakṣyāmi caturmūrtivrataṃ tava ..
śaṅkhacakragadāpadmaścaturātmā prakīrtitaḥ.. 1 ..
vāsudevaḥ smṛtaḥ śaṅkhaścakraṃ saṃkarṣaṇastathā ..
pradyumnaśca gadā padmamaniruddho jagadguruḥ..2..
śrāvaṇādiṣu māseṣu bahiḥ snānastu bhaktabhuk ..
teṣāṃ saṃpūjanaṃ kuryātpratimāsamataḥ kramāt..3..
gandhamālya namaskāradhūpadīpānnasaṃpadā ..
tatastu kārtikasyānte samāpte tu tathā vrate..4..
brāhmaṇānbhojayedbhaktyā dadyācchaktyā ca dakṣiṇām ..
kāṃsyapātraṃ ca saghṛtaṃ sasuvarṇaṃ tathaiva ca..5..
3.30.d:
एवं संवत्सरं कृत्वा व्रतं पुरुषसत्तम ॥
सर्वकामसमृद्धस्य यज्ञस्य फलमश्नुते ॥ 7 ॥
मानुष्यमासाद्य भवत्यरोगो वसुन्धरेशो विजितारिपक्षः ॥
जन्मान्तरे स्याद्द्विजवर्यमुख्यो वेदप्रसक्तो बहुयज्ञयाजी॥8॥
3.148
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
इदमन्यत्प्रवक्ष्यामि चतुर्मूर्तिव्रतं तव ॥
शङ्खचक्रगदापद्मश्चतुरात्मा प्रकीर्तितः॥ 1 ॥
वासुदेवः स्मृतः शङ्खश्चक्रं संकर्षणस्तथा ॥
प्रद्युम्नश्च गदा पद्ममनिरुद्धो जगद्गुरुः॥2॥
श्रावणादिषु मासेषु बहिः स्नानस्तु भक्तभुक् ॥
तेषां संपूजनं कुर्यात्प्रतिमासमतः क्रमात्॥3॥
गन्धमाल्य नमस्कारधूपदीपान्नसंपदा ॥
ततस्तु कार्तिकस्यान्ते समाप्ते तु तथा व्रते॥4॥
ब्राह्मणान्भोजयेद्भक्त्या दद्याच्छक्त्या च दक्षिणाम् ॥
कांस्यपात्रं च सघृतं ससुवर्णं तथैव च॥5॥
3.30.m:
Having observed this vow for a year, O best of men, / one enjoys the fruit of a sacrifice rich in all desires.
Attaining human birth, he becomes free from disease, a ruler of the earth whose enemies are conquered; / in another birth he will be foremost among the best of twice-born, devoted to the Vedas, offering many sacrifices.
Mārkaṇḍeya said: / I will declare another vow of the Four Forms for you. / Conch, discus, mace, and lotus are proclaimed as the four-fold Self.
Vāsudeva is considered the conch, and the discus is Saṃkarṣaṇa; / Pradyumna is the mace, and the lotus is Aniruddha, the teacher of the world.
In the months beginning with Śrāvaṇa, bathing outdoors and eating once a day, / one should worship them month by month, in proper sequence,
with an abundance of perfume, garlands, obeisance, incense, lamps, and food. / Then, at the end of Kārtika, when the vow has concluded,
one should feed brahmins with devotion and give a sacrificial fee according to one's capacity, / along with a bronze vessel filled with clarified butter and containing gold.

3.30.s:
kṛtvā vrataṃ māsacatuṣṭayaṃ tu prāpnoti lokaṃ tridaśeśvarasya..
mānuṣyamāsādya tatheha paścādvasundhareśo bhavatīha vīraḥ ..6..
3.149
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
idamanyatpravakṣyāsi caturmūrtivrataṃ tava ..
trirātropoṣitaḥ samyagvasante viṣuvaddine .. 1 ..
pūjāṃ kṛtvā yathāśakti vāsudevasya śatruhan ..
tato māsatrayaṃ nityaṃ vāsudevaṃ tu pūjayeta .. 2 ..
tacca māsatrayaṃ tiṣṭhetphalāhāro vicakṣaṇaḥ ..
tataḥ śāradamāsādya dharmajñaṃ viṣuvaddinam .. .. 3 ..
trirātropoṣitaḥ snātvā pradyumnaṃ pūjayetpriyam ..
homaṃ kṛtvā tatośnīyāddattvā dānaṃ ca śaktitaḥ .. 4 ..
prāṇayātrāṃ tu kurvīta yāvakena mahāmate..
vratāvasānamāsādya vāsantaṃ viṣuvaddinam ..
brāhmaṇaṃ bhojayecchaktyā dadyādvipreṣu dakṣiṇām ..5..
3.30.d:
कृत्वा व्रतं मासचतुष्टयं तु प्राप्नोति लोकं त्रिदशेश्वरस्य॥
मानुष्यमासाद्य तथेह पश्चाद्वसुन्धरेशो भवतीह वीरः ॥6॥
3.149
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
इदमन्यत्प्रवक्ष्यासि चतुर्मूर्तिव्रतं तव ॥
त्रिरात्रोपोषितः सम्यग्वसन्ते विषुवद्दिने ॥ 1 ॥
पूजां कृत्वा यथाशक्ति वासुदेवस्य शत्रुहन् ॥
ततो मासत्रयं नित्यं वासुदेवं तु पूजयेत ॥ 2 ॥
तच्च मासत्रयं तिष्ठेत्फलाहारो विचक्षणः ॥
ततः शारदमासाद्य धर्मज्ञं विषुवद्दिनम् ॥ ॥ 3 ॥
त्रिरात्रोपोषितः स्नात्वा प्रद्युम्नं पूजयेत्प्रियम् ॥
होमं कृत्वा ततोश्नीयाद्दत्त्वा दानं च शक्तितः ॥ 4 ॥
प्राणयात्रां तु कुर्वीत यावकेन महामते॥
व्रतावसानमासाद्य वासन्तं विषुवद्दिनम् ॥
ब्राह्मणं भोजयेच्छक्त्या दद्याद्विप्रेषु दक्षिणाम् ॥5॥
3.30.m:
Having observed this vow for four months, he attains the world of the lord of the gods; / and afterwards, attaining human birth here, he becomes a heroic ruler of the earth in this world.
Mārkaṇḍeya said: / I will declare another vow of the Four Forms for you. / Fasting properly for three nights on the equinox day in spring,
having performed worship of Vāsudeva according to one's capacity, O slayer of foes, / one should then constantly worship Vāsudeva for three months.
And during those three months the wise man should subsist on fruits. / Then, reaching the autumn equinox day, O knower of dharma,
having fasted for three nights and bathed, he should worship beloved Pradyumna. / Having performed a fire oblation, he should then eat and give gifts according to his capacity.
He should sustain his life on barley gruel, O high-minded one. / Reaching the end of the vow on the vernal equinox day, / he should feed a brahmin according to his capacity and give a sacrificial fee to the priests,

3.30.s:
kāñcanaṃ rajataṃ vastraṃ gāṃ ca yādavanandana ..
etatsaṃvatsaraṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ nāma haripriyam .. 6 ..
svargalokamavāpnoti bahukālamasaṃśayam ..
tato'śvilokānprāpnoti vasulokaṃ tato dvijaḥ .. 7 ..
viśveṣāṃ caiva devānāṃ tathaivāṅgirasāṃ dvijaḥ ..
rudrāṇāmatha sādhyānāṃ bhṛgūṇāṃ savitustathā ..8 ..
marutāmapi dharmajña śiśirāṃśostathaiva ca ..
prāpnoti devalokaṃ ca kāmacārī vihaṅgamaḥ .. 9 ..
prāpnoti lokaṃ sa hutāśanasya śakrasya devasya tathā harasya ..
lokaṃ samāsādya pitāmahasya tataḥ sa viṣṇoḥ puruṣaḥ prayāti .. 3.149.10 ..
3.150
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
idamanyatpravakṣyāmi caturmūrtivrataṃ tava ..
tasminneva vrate rājanmayā pūrvodite śubhe ..1..
viṣṇoḥ sthāne tvanantasya pūjā kāryā vijānatā ..
tasya saṃpūjanaṃ kṛtvā mahīgaganavedhasām .. 2 ..
3.30.d:
काञ्चनं रजतं वस्त्रं गां च यादवनन्दन ॥
एतत्संवत्सरं कृत्वा व्रतं नाम हरिप्रियम् ॥ 6 ॥
स्वर्गलोकमवाप्नोति बहुकालमसंशयम् ॥
ततोऽश्विलोकान्प्राप्नोति वसुलोकं ततो द्विजः ॥ 7 ॥
विश्वेषां चैव देवानां तथैवाङ्गिरसां द्विजः ॥
रुद्राणामथ साध्यानां भृगूणां सवितुस्तथा ॥8 ॥
मरुतामपि धर्मज्ञ शिशिरांशोस्तथैव च ॥
प्राप्नोति देवलोकं च कामचारी विहङ्गमः ॥ 9 ॥
प्राप्नोति लोकं स हुताशनस्य शक्रस्य देवस्य तथा हरस्य ॥
लोकं समासाद्य पितामहस्य ततः स विष्णोः पुरुषः प्रयाति ॥ 3.149.10 ॥
3.150
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
इदमन्यत्प्रवक्ष्यामि चतुर्मूर्तिव्रतं तव ॥
तस्मिन्नेव व्रते राजन्मया पूर्वोदिते शुभे ॥1॥
विष्णोः स्थाने त्वनन्तस्य पूजा कार्या विजानता ॥
तस्य संपूजनं कृत्वा महीगगनवेधसाम् ॥ 2 ॥
3.30.m:
[giving] gold, silver, cloth, and a cow, O descendant of Yadu. / Having observed this vow called Haripriya ('Dear to Hari') for a year,
he unquestionably attains heaven for a long time. / Then the twice-born reaches the worlds of the Aśvins, and after that the world of the Vasus,
and the twice-born reaches [the worlds] of the Viśvedevas, and likewise of the Aṅgirases, / of the Rudras, then of the Sādhyas, of the Bhṛgus, and of the Sun,
and of the Maruts, O knower of dharma, and likewise of the cool-rayed moon; / and moving at will like a bird, he reaches the world of the gods.
He reaches the world of the fire-eater [Agni], of the god Śakra, and of Hara; / reaching the world of the Grandfather [Brahmā], that man then goes to [the world of] Viṣṇu.
Mārkaṇḍeya said: / I will declare another vow of the Four Forms for you. / In that very auspicious vow previously spoken by me, O king,
worship of Ananta should be performed in place of Viṣṇu by the discerning one. / Having worshipped him, [the worship] of the Earth, the Sky, and the Creator

3.30.m:
should properly be performed on the second and subsequent [days] by one whose senses are controlled. / The wise man should worship Ananta according to rule on the first day.
Having observed this vow for a full year, a man then / attains the world of Viṣṇu for as long as fourteen Indras [endure].
Attaining human birth, he becomes free from disease, master of his senses, devoted to truth, humble, / endowed with wealth, beauty, and happiness, delightful to people, and beloved of women.
